66329.recognize_zh: 肝臟切片中淋巴球不在門脈區聚集，而是沿著竇狀隙 (sinusoids) 排成一串（黃色箭頭），CD3 陽性、CD5 缺失、CD8 部分陽性，這種竇狀隙分布的異常 T 細胞是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤 (HSTCL) 的特徵。
features: Panel A (H&E): mildly dilated hepatic sinusoids containing small clusters of medium-sized lymphocytes aligned in single file (arrowheads)
Panel A: hepatocyte plates preserved with pale, clear to finely vacuolated cytoplasm; no portal-based infiltrate or mass lesion in this field
Panel B: CD3 highlights numerous intrasinusoidal lymphocytes in a linear, branching pattern
Panel C: CD5 is essentially negative in the sinusoidal cells, with only rare positive cells (loss of pan-T antigen)
Panel D: CD8 shows partial positivity in the sinusoidal lymphocytes
66329.describe_en: Core liver biopsy shows preserved lobular architecture with mildly dilated sinusoids containing an increased number of medium-sized lymphocytes distributed in an intrasinusoidal, single-file pattern, without a portal-predominant infiltrate. By immunohistochemistry, the sinusoidal lymphocytes are CD3 positive with loss of CD5 and only partial CD8 expression. The CD3+ cells markedly outnumber CD5+ cells, indicating an aberrant T-cell population. Findings are suggestive of hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with TCR gamma-delta (or alpha-beta) staining, cytotoxic markers, flow cytometry and cytogenetics (isochromosome 7q, trisomy 8) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Viral hepatitis shows mixed CD8+ T cells that retain CD5 and usually has portal and lobular inflammation with hepatocyte injury.
T-LGL cells are small with azurophilic granules and typically CD8+/CD57+ with preserved or dim CD5, and marrow involvement is interstitial rather than a predominant hepatosplenic sinusoidal pattern.
NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3 negative (cytoplasmic CD3ε only) and EBER positive.

ddx.dx: Hepatic involvement by other peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS usually forms portal-based or mass-like infiltrates of pleomorphic cells rather than a monotonous sinusoidal pattern.

66457.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片 (A) 為大量圓形大母細胞、染色質細緻並帶嗜酸性顆粒與細胞質突起；butyrate esterase (B) 呈瀰漫紅棕色陽性、MPO (C) 同時陽性，流式 (D) 母細胞落在顆粒球區且 CD64/CD15/CD33 陽性、CD34/CD117/HLA-DR 陰性，顯示顆粒球與單核球混合表型。
features: Panel A: sheets of large round blasts with high N:C ratio, fine dispersed chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm with scattered granules and cytoplasmic blebs; a maturing granulocyte is also present
Panel B: nonspecific (butyrate) esterase shows diffuse strong red-brown cytoplasmic positivity in the blasts
Panel C: myeloperoxidase shows blue-green granular positivity in blasts, with one negative cell
Panel D (flow): CD45/SSC plot with the dominant population in the granulocytic region rather than the blast gate
Panel D (flow): blasts CD64+, CD15+, CD33 bright, CD38+, partial CD4 and CD13, and negative for CD123, HLA-DR, CD117 and CD34
66457.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of large round blasts with fine chromatin, moderate basophilic cytoplasm, scattered granules and cytoplasmic blebs. Cytochemistry demonstrates strong butyrate esterase positivity and concurrent myeloperoxidase positivity in the blasts. Flow cytometry shows that the leukemic cells fall within the granulocytic region of the CD45/side-scatter plot and express CD64, CD15, bright CD33, CD38 and partial CD4 and CD13, while lacking CD34, CD117, CD123 and HLA-DR. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with a single blast population showing hybrid granulocytic and monocytic features, in keeping with the known NPM1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Pure monocytic AML is MPO weak/negative with strong NSE and CD14/CD11c expression, whereas these blasts are also strongly MPO and CD15 positive.
APL is also CD34/HLA-DR negative with high side scatter but shows strong MPO with NSE negativity, bilobed or hypergranular cells and PML::RARA, unlike these NSE-positive round blasts.
Classic AMML contains separate blast, granulocytic and monocytic populations each ≥20%, whereas here a single population carries both lineage features.
Reactive states show a full maturation spectrum with CD16/CD14 acquisition rather than monotonous immature cells lacking maturation markers.

66265.recognize_zh: 八格組合圖：A 圖 H&E 骨切片被單調的小至中型未成熟細胞（核圓、細胞質少）取代；免疫染色 PAX5（B）、TdT（C）、CD10（F）、CD79a（G）強陽性，CD34 局部陽性（D），但 CD19（E）幾乎全陰、CD22 僅弱陽性（H），重點是認出 CD19 陰性的 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: Panel A (H&E): bone biopsy with marrow replaced by sheets of monotonous small to medium immature cells with scant cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei (inset)
Panel B: diffuse strong nuclear PAX5 positivity
Panel C: diffuse strong nuclear TdT positivity; Panel D: focal CD34 positivity
Panel E: CD19 essentially negative in the blasts, with only rare scattered positive cells
Panel F: strong diffuse CD10; Panel G: CD79a positive; Panel H: CD22 weak in a subset
66265.describe_en: Bone biopsy from a lytic lesion shows marrow replacement by sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized immature cells with scant cytoplasm and round to oval nuclei. By immunohistochemistry, the blasts are strongly positive for PAX5, TdT, CD10 and CD79a, focally positive for CD34 and weakly positive for CD22 in a subset, but are negative for CD19. The provided panel also reports negativity for CD20, T-cell markers, CD117, MPO, CK20 and neuroendocrine markers. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with an unusual de novo CD19-negative immunophenotype, which has implications for CD19-directed therapy and MRD monitoring.

ddx.vs: Merkel cell carcinoma can express PAX5 and TdT but is CK20 dot-positive and expresses synaptophysin, chromogranin and INSM1, while lacking CD10 and CD79a.
T-LBL shares TdT and CD34 positivity but expresses cytoplasmic CD3, CD7 and CD1a and lacks PAX5 and CD79a.

ddx.dx: Ewing sarcoma or other small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma is CD99 and NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement and lacks PAX5, CD79a and TdT.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with aberrant PAX5 (e.g., t(8;21))
ddx.vs: AML with t(8;21) can express PAX5 and CD19 but is MPO and CD117 positive, which were negative here.

66265.stain: H&E; IHC: PAX5, TdT, CD34, CD19, CD10, CD79a, CD22

66137.recognize_zh: 箭頭上方的圓形細胞胞質充滿粗大、深紫黑色的嗜鹼性顆粒，顆粒覆蓋並遮住核的輪廓，細胞邊緣也有顆粒突出，這就是嗜鹼性球（basophil）；左上角為嗜中性球可作大小對照。
features: Round cell slightly smaller than neighboring neutrophil, filled with coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules
Granules overlie and obscure the nucleus so that nuclear lobation is not discernible
Granules extend to the cell margin giving a slightly scalloped outline
Neutrophil at upper left, a mononuclear cell adjacent, and larger cells with basophilic cytoplasm at lower right
Background normochromic red cells with scattered platelets
66137.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a basophil (arrow) containing abundant coarse, dark purple-black cytoplasmic granules that obscure the nucleus and extend to the cell margin. A segmented neutrophil at the upper left, an adjacent mononuclear cell and larger cells with basophilic cytoplasm at the lower right edge are also present. Red cells are normochromic. Findings are consistent with a basophil; basophilia on the differential, particularly with immature myeloid cells, should raise consideration of a myeloproliferative neoplasm such as CML.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus visible between uniform granules and abundant cytoplasm, and are rare in blood outside systemic mastocytosis or mast cell leukemia.
Eosinophils have uniform orange-red refractile granules and a clearly visible bilobed nucleus, rather than dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus.
Toxic granules are fine to medium dark granules in a neutrophil with a visible multilobed nucleus and pink cytoplasm, not coarse granules masking the nucleus.
Stain precipitate also deposits on red cells and background and lies in a different focal plane, whereas true basophil granules are confined to the cell.

66073.recognize_zh: 這不是形態圖：左側為 IGH 基因重排 PCR 毛細管電泳圖，兩組反應各出現單一高聳峰（256 nt 與 115 nt，均大於背景 20 倍），代表單株 B 細胞；右側流式細胞儀顯示 CD45 中等、SSC 中等的族群，以 CD20 陽性、CD19 陰性為主。
features: IGH PCR fragment analysis (two reactions): dominant single peak at 256 nt and at 115 nt, each more than 20-fold above polyclonal background
Minimal Gaussian polyclonal background, supporting a clonal B-cell population
Flow cytometry CD45 vs SSC: gated events with intermediate CD45 and intermediate side scatter
CD19 vs CD20 plot: majority of events CD20-positive/CD19-negative (54.89%), with only 2.88% CD19+CD20+ and 0.48% CD19+CD20-
CD20 staining forms a continuous smear from negative to positive, so the CD20+CD19- gate should be interpreted with care
66073.describe_en: This figure shows ancillary studies rather than morphology. IGH gene rearrangement PCR with capillary electrophoresis demonstrates a dominant peak at 256 nucleotides in one reaction and 115 nucleotides in the other, each more than 20 times the height of the polyclonal background, indicating a clonal B-cell population. CSF flow cytometry shows a population with intermediate CD45 and side scatter that is predominantly CD20-positive and CD19-negative. Together with CSF cytology, these findings support involvement of the CSF by a clonal B-cell lymphoma, consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; loss of CD19 is an aberrant phenotype worth noting, for instance before CD19-directed therapy.

ddx.vs: Reactive B cells produce a Gaussian distribution of many peaks without a single dominant amplicon and show a mixed CD19+CD20+ population with balanced light chains.
Paucicellular CSF can yield spurious peaks, which are excluded by reproducing the same-size peak in duplicate reactions and correlating with flow cytometry and cytology.

65881.recognize_zh: 一群中到大型母細胞，染色質細緻、可見小核仁，細胞質中等量呈灰藍色且無顆粒，部分有小空泡；下方一顆母細胞細胞質拉長成尾巴（hand-mirror）。形態不具特異性，PICALM::MLLT10 需分子檢測確認。
features: Cluster of medium-to-large blasts with high to moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli in some cells
Moderate amount of pale grey-blue agranular cytoplasm, occasionally with small punched-out vacuoles
One blast with a polarized cytoplasmic tail producing hand-mirror morphology
No Auer rods visible; several disrupted/smudged cells with reticular chromatin in the background
65881.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive-appearing cluster of medium-to-large blasts with oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate, lightly basophilic and agranular, with occasional small vacuoles; one blast shows a single elongated cytoplasmic tail (hand-mirror form). No Auer rods are seen, and there are scattered disrupted cells in the background. The morphology is that of an acute leukemia with nonspecific, minimally differentiated blasts; lineage assignment and the PICALM::MLLT10 fusion require flow cytometry and molecular studies.

ddx.vs: PICALM::MLLT10 also occurs in T-ALL, and aberrant CD7 is common in this AML, so cCD3 versus MPO on flow is required to separate them.

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Monoblasts usually have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive; KMT2A FISH distinguishes the fusion partner.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical and separation relies on detection of the PICALM::MLLT10 fusion by RT-PCR, FISH or sequencing.
B-ALL blasts typically have scantier cytoplasm and are CD19/CD79a/TdT positive without myeloid antigens.

65753.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血抹片中，母細胞大量增加並成群出現，細胞核深紫、核質比高、細胞質少，背景散在許多破碎的塗抹細胞（smudge cells）；在此倍率只能判斷為急性白血病，杯狀核需高倍確認。
features: Marked leukocytosis composed almost entirely of monotonous blasts, frequently in small clusters
Blasts of medium-to-large size with high N:C ratio and dark nuclei
Scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Numerous smudge/disrupted cells scattered throughout
Nuclear detail and cup-shaped invaginations are not resolvable at this low magnification
65753.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows marked leukocytosis composed almost exclusively of blasts, many arranged in small aggregates, with numerous smudged cells in the background. The blasts are medium-to-large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm; normal leukocytes are virtually absent. Fine nuclear features, including the cup-shaped invaginations described, cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute leukemia with hyperleukocytosis, shown in this case by flow cytometry to be pre-B lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: At low power they may look similar, but AML blasts often show granules or Auer rods at high power and are MPO positive without B-lineage markers.
CLL shows small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and smudge cells, not large blasts.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of mantle cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Leukemic MCL has TdT-negative mature B cells with surface light chain restriction and cyclin D1 expression.
Burkitt cells show deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT negative.

65817.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中可同時見到骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核、分節嗜中性球，加上兩顆深紫黑色顆粒的嗜鹼性球與嗜伊紅性球，這種「完整左移＋嗜鹼性球、嗜伊紅性球增多」是 CML 的典型組合。
features: Marked leukocytosis with granulocytes at every maturation stage
Two basophils with coarse dark purple-black granules
Eosinophils with orange refractile granules, including an eosinophilic myelocyte
Clustered myelocytes and promyelocytes with round nuclei and granular cytoplasm
Blasts not increased; no dysplasia of neutrophils
Platelets present; red cells with mild anisocytosis
65817.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a complete spectrum of granulocytic maturation from promyelocytes to segmented neutrophils, with a predominance of myelocytes and mature neutrophils. Basophils and eosinophils are increased, and blasts are not increased in this field. There is no granulocytic dysplasia. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction lacks basophilia and eosinophilia and shows toxic granulation, with a high LAP score.
aCML has dysplastic granulocytes and basophils under 2%.
CEL is dominated by eosinophils rather than a myelocyte-rich neutrophilic series with basophils.

65689.recognize_zh: 三顆形態正常的嗜中性球外緣都被一圈小小紫色血小板環繞貼附，形成像衛星圍繞的花環；血小板緊貼在白血球表面而不是散在背景，就是 EDTA 引起的血小板衛星現象，會造成血小板數假性偏低。
features: Three mature neutrophils each rimmed by a ring of adherent platelets (rosette formation)
Platelets of normal size and granularity arranged around the neutrophil membrane
Neutrophils otherwise normal with segmented nuclei and fine granules
Few free platelets in the background
Normocytic, normochromic red cells
65689.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several morphologically normal segmented neutrophils, each encircled by a rim of adherent normal-appearing platelets forming rosettes. Relatively few free platelets are seen in the background. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent platelet satellitism, an in vitro artifact that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a platelet count on a citrate-anticoagulated or fingerstick sample is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets without platelet rosetting around neutrophils or platelet clumps.
Platelet clumping forms free aggregates of platelets, often at the feathered edge, rather than rings around neutrophils.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm, whereas satellitism shows platelets attached to the cell surface.
Toxic granules are intracytoplasmic dark azurophilic granules, not discrete platelets arranged outside the cell border.

65561.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球旁有一群比紅血球小很多（約 2–4 µm）的橢圓形酵母樣體，每顆都有偏於一側的新月形深藍色核物質與周圍透明暈（halo），位於細胞外，提示全身性真菌血症（形態最像 Histoplasma）。
features: Extracellular cluster of about 12 small oval yeast-like organisms, much smaller than red cells (approximately 2-4 µm)
Each organism has a crescent-shaped, eccentric basophilic nuclear/cytoplasmic mass
Clear unstained halo (pseudocapsule) surrounding each organism
No budding, hyphae or central septation evident at this resolution
Adjacent leukocyte (likely monocyte) with granular cytoplasm and a vacuole; background red cells
65561.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an extracellular cluster of numerous small, oval yeast-like organisms, considerably smaller than red cells, each with an eccentric crescent-shaped basophilic nucleus and a surrounding clear halo. An adjacent leukocyte with granular, vacuolated cytoplasm is present, and the organisms may have been released from a disrupted phagocyte. No budding, hyphae or septation is identified. Findings are suggestive of systemic fungemia; the morphology most closely resembles Histoplasma capsulatum, but culture, antigen testing or molecular studies are required for species identification.

ddx.vs: Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission and show a characteristic central transverse septum with elongated sausage forms, rather than budding oval forms with crescentic nuclei.
Candida yeasts are slightly larger, stain more uniformly, lack a crescent-shaped nucleus with clear halo, and may show pseudohyphae.
Amastigotes contain both a round nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast without a clear capsule-like halo.
Platelets have granular purple centers without halos and stain precipitate is irregular, whereas these are uniform oval bodies with internal crescentic nuclei.

65625.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片滿是胞質充滿粗大紫紅色顆粒、核圓或腎形的異常前骨髓細胞，形態像 APL；但 PML::RARA 陰性，核型顯示第 3、7 號染色體重排及 Y 缺失，光學基因體定序（OGM）圈圖呈多染色體斷點的 chromoplexy，Sanger 定序證實 FNDC3B::RARB 融合，屬 RARA 陰性的 APL 樣白血病。
features: BM aspirate: sheets of large abnormal promyelocyte-like cells with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse red-purple azurophilic granules
Round to reniform, sometimes eccentric nuclei with fine chromatin; granules partly obscure nuclear detail
Karyotype: rearranged chromosomes 3 and 7 (arrows) and loss of Y
Optical genome mapping circos plot: multiple interconnected translocation links between chromosome 3 and 7 loci (chromoplexy) producing FNDC3B::RARB
Sanger chromatogram: in-frame junction joining FNDC3B exon 6 to RARB exon 2
65625.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked replacement by large abnormal promyelocyte-like cells with abundant cytoplasm containing dense, coarse azurophilic granules and round to reniform nuclei, morphologically indistinguishable from hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia. The accompanying karyotype demonstrates structural rearrangement of chromosomes 3 and 7 with loss of the Y chromosome, and optical genome mapping resolves a complex multi-breakpoint chromoplexy generating an FNDC3B::RARB fusion, confirmed by RT-PCR with Sanger sequencing across the FNDC3B exon 6-RARB exon 2 junction. PML::RARA was not detected. Findings are consistent with an APL-like acute myeloid leukemia with a variant RARB rearrangement, which is expected to be poorly responsive to retinoids.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; separation requires FISH/RT-PCR demonstrating PML::RARA, which was negative here.

ddx.dx: APL with other RARA partners (ZBTB16::RARA, NPM1::RARA, STAT5B::RARA)
ddx.vs: These involve the RARA locus at 17q21 and are detected with RARA break-apart FISH, whereas this case rearranges RARB at 3p24.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation (hypergranular) or AML with NPM1 mutation
ddx.vs: Show more blasts with less dense granulation, often HLA-DR or CD34 expression and lack RAR-family fusions.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocyte-rich marrow (G-CSF recovery, agranulocytosis recovery)
ddx.vs: Promyelocytes are normal in appearance with progressive maturation and a normal karyotype, without clonal RAR rearrangement.

65241.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量增加，可見多顆大小不一、部分成群的巨核細胞，旁邊有紅血球島與顆粒球前驅細胞，並夾雜一片小淋巴球聚集；形態屬非特異的高細胞性骨髓，需結合抹片空泡與 UBA1 突變判讀為 VEXAS。
features: Hypercellular marrow with residual fat spaces
Increased megakaryocytes of variable size, focally loosely clustered, some with hypolobated nuclei
Erythroid islands with round dark nuclei and expanded granulocytic precursors
Interstitial collection of small mature lymphocytes without a well-formed nodule
No sheets of blasts, granulomas or metastatic tumor
65241.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are increased and variable in size, with focal loose clustering and some hypolobated forms, and erythroid islands and granulocytic precursors are expanded. A small interstitial collection of mature lymphocytes is present without a discrete lymphoid nodule. There are no sheets of blasts, granulomas, or metastatic tumor cells. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant and vacuolated precursors on the aspirate, findings are consistent with the hypercellular, mildly dysplastic marrow of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS shows similar hypercellularity and dysmegakaryopoiesis; UBA1 sequencing and inflammatory clinical features distinguish VEXAS.
MPNs show tight clusters of large hyperlobated or cloud-like megakaryocytes, often with reticulin fibrosis, and JAK2/CALR/MPL driver mutations.
Lymphoma forms nodular, paratrabecular or interstitial monotypic aggregates confirmed by CD20 and light chain restriction, unlike this small reactive-appearing lymphoid collection.

65305.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央的顆粒內有許多巨噬細胞，細胞質中擠滿大量細小的紫色點狀體（Leishman-Donovan bodies），周邊還有游離於細胞外的原蟲與被吞噬的有核細胞，符合利什曼原蟲病。
features: Cellular marrow particle with numerous macrophages and admixed hematopoietic cells
Macrophage cytoplasm packed with innumerable tiny dark purple dot-like amastigotes
Extracellular organisms scattered around the particle
Macrophages with ingested nucleated cells suggestive of hemophagocytosis
Low-intermediate magnification; nucleus and kinetoplast not individually resolved
65305.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular particle containing numerous macrophages with abundant cytoplasm packed with innumerable tiny dark-staining dot-like bodies. Similar bodies are scattered extracellularly around the particle, and some macrophages contain ingested nucleated cells. The organisms are too small at this magnification to resolve the nucleus and kinetoplast; oil-immersion examination is recommended. Findings are consistent with Leishman-Donovan bodies of visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are surrounded by a clear halo and lack a kinetoplast, and are GMS-positive.
T. marneffei yeasts show central septation (binary fission) rather than a nucleus with an adjacent kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Platelet or stain precipitate overlying macrophages
ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular, variably sized and present on the slide background, unlike uniform oval organisms confined to macrophages and their vicinity.

65177.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中散見中央呈裂隙狀淡染區的口形紅血球（stomatocytes，星號）與少數中央有橫隔、似捏過的 knizocytes（箭頭），搭配 MCHC 升高與 ektacytometry 曲線左移（去水型），提示 PIEZO1 遺傳性乾燥球增多症。
features: Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic with preserved density
Scattered stomatocytes with slit-like or mouth-shaped central pallor (stars)
Rare knizocytes (pinched red cells with a central bar/ridge) (arrows)
No spherocytes, fragments or target cell predominance; scattered normal platelets

Osmotic gradient ektacytometry: patient curve shifted left with lower Omin (133 vs 140 mOsm/kg) and lower Ohyper (417 vs 452 mOsm/kg) and preserved maximal deformability, indicating dehydrated red cells
65177.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with scattered stomatocytes and rare knizocytes; spherocytes and schistocytes are not seen. The osmotic gradient ektacytometry profile shows a left-shifted curve with reduced Omin and Ohyper and near-normal maximal deformability, a pattern of red cell dehydration. In a patient with erythrocytosis, high MCHC, increased hemoglobin-oxygen affinity and a PIEZO1 variant, findings are consistent with dehydrated hereditary stomatocytosis (hereditary xerocytosis).

ddx.vs: OHSt shows numerous stomatocytes with macrocytosis and low MCHC and a right-shifted ektacytometry curve, opposite to the dehydrated left shift seen here.
HS shows spherocytes lacking central pallor and a curve with elevated Omin and reduced maximal deformability rather than a left shift with preserved deformability.
Artifactual stomatocytes appear only in thick areas of the smear, whereas true stomatocytosis is supported by consistent red cell indices and ektacytometry.

ddx.dx: Polycythemia vera or high-affinity hemoglobin variant
ddx.vs: PV is JAK2 positive with low erythropoietin and HbHA shows normal red cell morphology, whereas this patient had stomatocytes and a dehydrated ektacytometric profile.

64985.recognize_zh: H&E 顯示瀰漫的多形性浸潤，以漿細胞、漿細胞樣細胞及中型淋巴樣細胞為主；EBER 只標記零星散在的細胞，kappa 與 lambda 皆有大量陽性細胞（多株性），這種 EBV 陽性、輕鏈不受限的多形性增生符合 EBV 相關淋巴增生性疾病，而非單株淋巴瘤或漿細胞腫瘤。
features: Dense polymorphous infiltrate of plasma cells, plasmacytoid cells, small to intermediate lymphocytes and occasional larger blasts
Plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hofs; scattered cells with clear cytoplasmic halos
No sheets of monotonous large atypical cells or Reed-Sternberg-like cells in this field
EBER ISH: scattered, single positive nuclei of small to medium cells
Kappa and lambda both expressed by numerous plasma cells (polytypic pattern)
64985.describe_en: H&E section shows a dense polymorphous infiltrate composed of numerous plasma cells and plasmacytoid cells admixed with small and intermediate lymphocytes and occasional larger transformed cells, without sheets of monotonous atypical large cells or Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells. EBER in situ hybridization highlights scattered single positive small to medium-sized cells. Kappa and lambda immunostains show abundant positive plasma cells for both light chains, indicating a polytypic population. Findings are consistent with an EBV-driven polymorphic lymphoproliferative disorder; the specimen type (lymph node vs marrow) is not determinable from these fields alone.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells show kappa or lambda light chain restriction and are usually EBER-negative, unlike this polytypic infiltrate.
cHL requires CD30+/CD15+ PAX5-dim Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in an inflammatory background, which are not identified.
EBV+ DLBCL shows sheets of large EBER-positive B cells with monoclonality, rather than scattered EBER+ cells in a polytypic background.
AITL also contains scattered EBER+ B blasts and polytypic plasma cells, but has atypical CD10+/PD-1+ TFH cells, HEV proliferation and clonal TCR rearrangement.

65049.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中紅血球大小不一，散在多個頭盔狀與三角形碎片的裂紅血球（schistocytes，黑色箭頭），另有鋸齒狀細胞，血小板稀少；藍色箭頭處一個紅血球旁有圓形深藍色核狀物，對應描述中的正在脫核紅血球。大量裂紅血球配合血小板低與腎衰竭，符合血栓性微血管病變（Shiga 毒素相關 HUS）。
features: Anisocytosis with numerous schistocytes, including helmet cells, triangular fragments and keratocytes (black arrow)
Scattered crenated/spiculated red cell fragments and occasional small dense cells
Dark blue round nuclear body closely apposed to a red cell (blue arrow), consistent with a nucleus being extruded from a nucleated RBC
Paucity of platelets in the field, compatible with thrombocytopenia
Thin rod-shaped extracellular artifacts/stain debris in the background; no leukocytes in the field
65049.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisocytosis with numerous schistocytes per high-power field, including helmet cells, triangular fragments and keratocytes, together with crenated fragmented forms. A red cell with an adjacent dense blue round nucleus is present, interpreted as a nucleus being extruded from a nucleated red cell. Platelets are sparse, and occasional linear stain precipitates are present as artifact. Findings are consistent with a thrombotic microangiopathy with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, in keeping with the reported Shiga toxin 2-induced hemolytic uremic syndrome; ADAMTS13 activity should be measured to exclude TTP.

ddx.vs: TTP shows an identical schistocyte-rich smear, so severe ADAMTS13 deficiency (<10%) rather than morphology separates it from STEC-HUS.
aHUS is morphologically indistinguishable and is diagnosed by negative STEC testing, normal ADAMTS13 and complement studies or genetic testing.
DIC can produce schistocytes but is accompanied by prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, which are usually normal or near-normal in HUS.
Valve-related fragmentation lacks thrombocytopenia and renal failure, and burns produce microspherocytes and budding fragments with a clear clinical history.

64921.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆大型巨噬細胞，細胞質淡藍、有細小顆粒，內含一個被透明空泡包住的有核細胞；巨噬細胞本身的橢圓形細胞核被擠到一側，整體看起來像印戒細胞，其實是吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Large macrophage with abundant pale grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and irregular cytoplasmic borders
Engulfed nucleated cell (round dense nucleus, likely lymphocyte or erythroid precursor) within a clear phagocytic vacuole
Macrophage nucleus oval with fine chromatin, displaced eccentrically by the vacuole, mimicking a signet ring cell
Adjacent small lymphocyte with scant cytoplasm and scattered platelets in the background
Numerous overlapping red cells from a thick area of the smear
64921.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm containing an intact nucleated cell within a clear phagocytic vacuole. The vacuole displaces the macrophage's oval nucleus to one side, producing a signet ring-like appearance. No cohesive clusters or atypical epithelial cells are present, and the macrophage nucleus is bland. In a patient after CAR T-cell therapy with cytokine release syndrome, the finding is consistent with hemophagocytosis, supporting immune effector cell-associated HLH-like syndrome when clinical and laboratory criteria are met.

ddx.vs: True signet ring cells are cohesive with a mucin vacuole and a hyperchromatic, atypical crescentic nucleus, whereas this cell has a bland macrophage nucleus and its vacuole contains an engulfed nucleated cell.
Emperipolesis occurs within megakaryocytes with large lobulated nuclei and intact living cells moving through the cytoplasm, not within a monolobed macrophage.

ddx.dx: Tingible body macrophage with apoptotic debris
ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain fragmented apoptotic nuclear debris rather than an intact nucleated hematopoietic cell, which is what defines hemophagocytosis.

64857.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的晚期紅血球母細胞，核旁細胞質內有數顆小而圓、深紫色、類似 Howell-Jolly 小體的核碎片；旁邊還有核分裂象與大型空泡狀細胞，屬於骨髓造血不良（MDS）的紅系異形變化。
features: Late erythroblasts with round nuclei and clumped chromatin (arrows)
Multiple small, round, dense, dark-purple Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions in erythroblast cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus
Other erythroblasts with fine peripheral dot-like inclusions at the cell margin
A mitotic figure (left) and immature cells with open chromatin in the field
Occasional large vacuolated cell and granulocytic precursors in the background
64857.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors with multiple small, round, densely basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (arrows), indicative of nuclear fragmentation/karyorrhexis. A mitotic figure and scattered immature myeloid cells are also present. These nuclear debris-type inclusions within erythroblasts represent dyserythropoiesis. Findings are consistent with dyserythropoietic change as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm, to be correlated with blast count, cytogenetics and exclusion of nutritional or drug-related causes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroblasts show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, and correct with vitamin replacement.
Pappenheimer bodies are smaller, clustered granules that stain with Prussian blue, whereas Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions are larger DNA remnants.
Drug-induced dyserythropoiesis may look identical and requires clinical history and resolution after withdrawal.
CDA presents in young patients with isolated erythroid dysplasia such as internuclear bridging or binucleation, without cytopenias of other lineages or clonal markers.

64601.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中沒有可見的宿主細胞，只見一群聚集與散在的短小桿菌（bacilli），染成藍色；型態只能說明是桿菌感染，無法區分綠膿桿菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）與陰溝腸桿菌（Enterobacter cloacae），需靠革蘭染色與培養鑑定。
features: Clustered aggregate of numerous short, straight rod-shaped bacteria with rounded ends
Additional scattered single bacilli throughout the field
Bacteria stain blue with this Romanowsky-type stain; Gram reaction cannot be assessed
No neutrophils or other host inflammatory cells visible in this field
Clean proteinaceous background; organisms are uniform without spores or capsules evident
64601.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a cluster and scattered single short, straight bacilli with rounded ends, staining blue with a Romanowsky-type stain. No inflammatory cells are present in this field, and Gram reaction cannot be determined from this stain. The findings indicate bacterial organisms (bacilli) in the CSF, suggestive of bacterial meningitis or contamination; morphology cannot distinguish Pseudomonas aeruginosa from Enterobacter cloacae or other gram-negative rods, and identification requires Gram stain and culture with susceptibility testing.

ddx.vs: These gram-negative rods are morphologically indistinguishable on smear and are separated by culture and biochemical/MALDI-TOF identification.
Listeria and diphtheroids are gram-positive short rods, often palisading or coccobacillary, which a Gram stain distinguishes.
Precipitate is irregular, refractile and variably sized, whereas bacteria are uniform rods with consistent width and rounded ends.

64665.recognize_zh: 兩格圖中的嗜酸性球（左為分葉成熟型，右為較大的嗜酸性骨髓細胞）細胞質內橘紅色嗜酸性顆粒之間混雜許多大而深紫色、類似嗜鹼性的顆粒，呈「雙色」外觀，即 harlequin cell（異常嗜酸性球），常與 inv(16) AML 相關。
features: Eosinophil lineage cells containing a mixture of orange-pink eosinophilic granules and large dark purple-violet basophilic-appearing granules
Left: mature-sized cell with a trilobed nucleus and admixed dark purple and pinkish granules
Right: larger immature eosinophil (myelocyte-stage) with a round-indented nucleus and abundant cytoplasm
Coarse, variably sized granules overlie the nucleus in the immature cell
Background red cells and platelets without notable abnormality
64665.describe_en: Bone marrow smear (two panels) shows eosinophil-lineage cells containing a mixture of typical orange-pink eosinophilic granules and large, dark purple-violet, basophil-like granules. The left panel shows a segmented eosinophil with a trilobed nucleus, and the right panel shows a larger immature eosinophil with a round to indented nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm with granules overlying the nucleus. These abnormal eosinophils with metachromatic granules (harlequin cells) are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with CBFB::MYH11 [inv(16)/t(16;16)] in the appropriate context, and cytogenetic or molecular confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Normal early eosinophils may contain a few basophilic-staining primary granules, but these are few and small rather than numerous large dark purple granules in otherwise mature eosinophils.
Basophils have uniformly dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus without an admixed orange-pink eosinophilic granule population.

ddx.dx: Eosinophilia in CML or myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia (PDGFRA)
ddx.vs: These may show dysplastic eosinophils with mixed granules too, so distinction requires BCR::ABL1, PDGFRA/B, FGFR1 or CBFB::MYH11 testing.
Mast cells are round-to-oval cells with a central round nucleus and dense purple granules only, lacking eosinophilic granules and nuclear lobation.

64473.recognize_zh: 閘選的細胞幾乎全部落在 CD13+33 陽性區，其中一大部分同時表現 CD34（Q2），並延續到 CD34 陰性區（Q4），顯示這群芽細胞為骨髓系並表現 CD34。
features: Dot plot of CD13+CD33 (PE, combined) versus CD34 (APC) on gated cells
Essentially all events are CD13/CD33 positive (right quadrants)
A large subset co-expresses CD34 (upper right quadrant Q2)
Remaining CD13/33-positive events extend continuously into the CD34-negative quadrant (Q4)
Virtually no events in CD13/33-negative quadrants (Q1, Q3)
64473.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of left knee joint fluid displays CD13/CD33 versus CD34 expression on the gated population. The cells are uniformly positive for the myeloid antigens CD13/CD33, and a substantial subset co-expresses CD34, with a continuum into a CD34-negative fraction. Because CD13 and CD33 share one fluorochrome, individual antigen expression cannot be separated on this plot, and the exact gating strategy is not shown. Findings support a CD34-positive myeloid blast population, consistent with joint fluid involvement by acute myeloid leukemia.

64409.recognize_zh: Prussian blue 染色的骨髓抹片顆粒（particle）中，佈滿大量粗大、成塊的藍色含鐵血黃素沉積，遠超過正常零星的細顆粒，表示骨髓鐵儲存明顯增加。
features: Bone marrow particle containing abundant coarse blue-staining hemosiderin granules and clumps
Iron deposits diffusely distributed throughout the particle, including large confluent aggregates
Pink-red nuclear fast red/safranin counterstain in the particle stroma
Image is out of focus; individual macrophages and erythroblasts (sideroblasts) cannot be assessed
64409.describe_en: Prussian blue stain of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a marrow particle heavily laden with coarse and confluent blue hemosiderin deposits, indicating markedly increased storage iron (high grade). The image is out of focus, so sideroblastic iron in individual erythroid precursors and ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated. Findings are consistent with marked iron overload; correlation with serum ferritin, transferrin saturation and transfusion history is required to determine the cause.

ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows only small scattered blue granules within a few macrophages rather than coarse confluent deposits filling the particle.
Inflammation increases macrophage storage iron but usually to a lesser degree, with reduced sideroblasts and low transferrin saturation.

ddx.dx: Ring sideroblast disorders (MDS-RS, congenital sideroblastic anemia)
ddx.vs: These require identification of erythroblasts with perinuclear iron granules encircling the nucleus, which cannot be assessed on this particle view.
Precipitate lies on top of the smear in a different focal plane and also appears outside cells and particles, whereas hemosiderin is confined to the particle and macrophages.

64281.recognize_zh: 低倍（A）血小板數量稀少，其中幾顆明顯變大（藍箭頭）而另有正常大小者（黑箭頭）；放大圖（B、C）的大血小板約為紅血球直徑的一半、顆粒正常，符合巨大血小板減少症（macrothrombocytopenia）。
features: Decreased platelet number relative to red cells in the low-power field (panel A)
Several large platelets, roughly one-third to one-half of red cell diameter, interspersed with a few normal-sized platelets
Enlarged platelets retain normal central azurophilic granules with pale blue peripheral hyalomere (panels B, C)
No platelet clumping and no hypogranular (gray) platelets
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
64281.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, a composite of a low-power field (A) and two high-power insets (B, C), shows a mildly reduced platelet count. Several platelets are enlarged, approaching one-half of red cell diameter, while a minority are normal in size; the enlarged platelets have normal granulation and are not clumped. Red cells and the visible background are unremarkable, and no leukocyte inclusions are seen in these fields. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia, which in a patient with 22q11.2 deletion is attributed to heterozygous loss of GP1BB.

ddx.vs: Bernard-Soulier platelets are often giant, exceeding red cell size, with more severe thrombocytopenia, bleeding, and absent ristocetin-induced agglutination on platelet aggregometry.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets together with Dohle-like basophilic inclusions in neutrophils and abnormal NMMHC-IIA immunofluorescence.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular, whereas these enlarged platelets contain normal purple granules.
ITP shows occasional large young platelets with an otherwise normal smear and responds to immune therapy; lifelong stable thrombocytopenia with a syndromic diagnosis favors an inherited cause.

64153.recognize_zh: 兩顆成熟分葉嗜中性球的細胞膜外緣，一圈圈貼附著多顆血小板，像衛星環繞；這就是血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism），多為 EDTA 相關的體外假象，可造成假性血小板減少。
features: Two mature segmented neutrophils with normal granular cytoplasm
Multiple platelets adherent to the outer cell membrane, forming a partial rosette around each neutrophil
Adherent platelets are of normal size and granularity
Few free platelets in the surrounding background
Red cells normocytic; small refractile artifacts on some red cells
64153.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils, each rimmed by several platelets adhering to the cell surface in a rosette-like pattern. The neutrophils themselves show normal nuclear segmentation and cytoplasmic granulation, and the adherent platelets are morphologically unremarkable. Few free platelets are present in the background. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-associated phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counts; a repeat count in citrate or heparin, or from a fingerstick smear, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Clumps are aggregates of platelets alone, often at the feathered edge, rather than platelets ringed around the neutrophil membrane.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm, often in vacuoles, rather than on the cell surface.
True thrombocytopenia shows scarce platelets throughout the smear without adherence or clumping and persists in non-EDTA anticoagulant.
Random overlap involves isolated platelets, whereas satellitism shows multiple platelets encircling many neutrophils across the film.

64089.recognize_zh: 肋膜積液抹片中幾乎全是單一型態、非黏聚的淋巴樣細胞，胞質深藍嗜鹼性、核質比高、核圓，並夾雜許多破裂後呈粉紅色的裸核；積液中出現這種大量單形性淋巴樣細胞，提示淋巴瘤侵犯（本例為 DLBCL）。
features: Hypercellular fluid dominated by a monotonous population of discohesive lymphoid cells
High N:C ratio with round nuclei and moderately coarse chromatin
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm; some cells with small cytoplasmic projections
Numerous larger pink-staining disrupted nuclei (lysed/bare nuclei) reflecting cell fragility
Mesothelial cells and mixed inflammatory cells are inconspicuous; cell size is hard to gauge because few red cells are present for comparison
64089.describe_en: Pleural fluid smear shows a markedly cellular specimen composed of a monotonous population of discohesive lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round nuclei, and narrow rims of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Numerous disrupted cells appear as enlarged pink-staining bare nuclei, indicating cellular fragility. Reactive mesothelial cells and a polymorphous inflammatory background are not conspicuous. Cell size is difficult to assess at this magnification without red cells for scale. The findings are suspicious for involvement by lymphoma, consistent with the clinical history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, and should be confirmed by flow cytometry or cell block immunohistochemistry.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphocytic effusion (e.g., tuberculosis, heart failure)
ddx.vs: Reactive effusions contain small mature lymphocytes with a mixed population and mesothelial cells, and are polytypic on flow cytometry.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing prominent lipid vacuoles and show MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%.
PEL cells are large, plasmablastic to immunoblastic, HHV-8 positive and usually lack CD20, occurring without a solid mass.
Small cell carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and is cytokeratin/neuroendocrine marker positive and CD45-negative.

63961.recognize_zh: A 圖抹片體部只有紅血球與兩個嗜中性球，幾乎看不到血小板；B 圖同一張片子的羽狀邊緣（feathered edge）卻有大片血小板聚集團，混有嗜中性球與單核球，表示是 EDTA 引起的假性血小板低下。
features: Panel A: body of smear with normal red cells and two segmented neutrophils but virtually no platelets
Panel B: feathered edge with large clumps of aggregated platelets
Leukocytes (a neutrophil and a monocyte) trapped adjacent to platelet aggregates
Individual platelets within clumps show normal granulation
No schistocytes or other red cell abnormalities to suggest true consumptive thrombocytopenia
63961.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from an EDTA-anticoagulated sample shows essentially no free platelets in the body of the smear, where red cells and neutrophils appear unremarkable (A). Examination of the feathered edge of the same slide reveals large platelet aggregates with entrapped leukocytes (B). Individual platelets within the clumps are normally granulated, and schistocytes are not seen. Findings are consistent with EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia; a repeat platelet count in citrate or heparin anticoagulant, or from a fingerstick smear, is recommended.

ddx.vs: True thrombocytopenia shows scarce platelets throughout the smear including the feathered edge, without platelet clumps.
Satellitism is also EDTA-related but shows platelets rosetting around individual neutrophils rather than large free aggregates.
Partially clotted samples show fibrin strands and may lower all counts, and a visible clot is often present in the tube.
Giant platelets are counted as red cells by analyzers but appear as single large platelets, not clumps, on the smear.

63769.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一團邊界模糊的上皮樣組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），核細長呈拖鞋狀、細胞質淡粉紅且界線不清，周圍被小淋巴球與漿細胞圍繞，即為肉芽腫。此視野未見乾酪樣壞死或多核巨細胞。
features: Loose, ill-defined aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes in the center of the field
Epithelioid cells have elongated, slipper- or boomerang-shaped vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders, giving a syncytial appearance
Surrounding cuff of small lymphocytes with admixed plasma cells
No caseous necrosis or multinucleated Langhans giant cells in this field
63769.describe_en: H&E-stained tissue section shows a cellular background containing an ill-defined aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes. At higher power, these cells have elongated, slipper-shaped vesicular nuclei and abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct borders, and they are cuffed by small lymphocytes and plasma cells. Caseous necrosis and multinucleated giant cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation; special stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi and culture are recommended, and in this case context an acid-fast stain supported tuberculosis.

ddx.vs: Sarcoid granulomas are typically tight, well-formed, non-necrotizing and have scant lymphocytic cuffing, with negative special stains and cultures.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with epithelioid histiocyte-rich background (e.g. Hodgkin or lymphoepithelioid T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma shows atypical large cells (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg or atypical T cells) among the histiocytes, confirmed by CD30/CD15 or T-cell immunohistochemistry.
Morphology is similar, so GMS or PAS stains showing yeast forms, rather than acid-fast bacilli, separate them.
Lipogranulomas contain fat vacuoles and drug-related granulomas are small and non-necrotizing with a supporting drug history.

63641.recognize_zh: 鐵染色（Prussian blue）下，右側有核的紅血球母細胞周圍排列多顆藍綠色鐵顆粒，沿核周環繞一大段，是環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；旁邊還有少數含零星藍色顆粒的無核紅血球（siderocyte）。
features: Nucleated erythroid precursors with red-counterstained nuclei surrounded by coarse blue-green iron granules
Granules arranged along the nuclear rim in a perinuclear (ring) distribution, qualifying as ring sideroblasts
Anucleate red cells containing a few scattered blue granules (siderocytes / Pappenheimer bodies)
Pale background red cells with some crenated forms
63641.describe_en: Iron-stained smear (Prussian blue with red counterstain) shows several nucleated erythroid precursors containing coarse blue-green siderotic granules arranged around the nuclear rim, consistent with ring sideroblasts. Occasional anucleate red cells contain scattered iron granules (siderocytes). The image is focused on a thin area and quantitation cannot be performed from this field. Findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts; in the appropriate setting, ≥15% of erythroid precursors (or ≥5% with SF3B1 mutation) supports a ring sideroblast-associated myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts have only a few fine granules scattered randomly in the cytoplasm, not five or more granules encircling at least one-third of the nucleus.
Siderocytes are anucleate red cells with scattered granules, whereas ring sideroblasts are nucleated precursors with perinuclear granules.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in the background in varying planes rather than being confined to the perinuclear cytoplasm of erythroblasts.

63577.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中出現大量中大型淋巴樣細胞，核呈多葉、腦迴或花瓣狀（flower cells），胞質淡藍嗜鹼性；CSF 中出現這種多葉核 T 細胞，配合 HTLV-1 陽性與高血鈣，指向成人 T 細胞白血病／淋巴瘤中樞神經侵犯。
features: Numerous medium to large atypical lymphoid cells in a cytocentrifuge preparation
Markedly convoluted, multilobated nuclei with clover-leaf/flower-like configurations (arrows)
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Moderate rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm
Few red cells and no neutrophils in the background; some cells show cytospin distortion
63577.describe_en: Cerebrospinal fluid cytocentrifuge preparation (Wright-Giemsa) shows a markedly increased population of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells. Many cells have deeply convoluted, multilobated, flower-like nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm. Inflammatory cells such as neutrophils are not seen, and no mitotic figures or large nucleoli are evident. In conjunction with a CD4+/CD7-/CD25+ T-cell phenotype, positive HTLV-1 serology and hypercalcemia, the findings are consistent with CNS involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Sézary syndrome / mycosis fungoides with CNS spread
ddx.vs: Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei rather than petal-like lobation, are usually CD25-negative, and occur without HTLV-1 infection.
Reactive CSF lymphocytes are mostly small with round nuclei and are admixed with monocytes and plasma cells, lacking a monomorphic flower-cell population.

ddx.dx: Cytospin artifact of neutrophils or monocytes
ddx.vs: Degenerating neutrophils have pyknotic separate lobes with granular pink cytoplasm and monocytes have folded nuclei with grey vacuolated cytoplasm, not basophilic lymphoid cytoplasm.
PTCL may show nuclear irregularity but lacks HTLV-1 clonal integration and the typical CD25-bright flower-cell morphology.

63449.recognize_zh: 厚層血片中紅血球已溶解成淡粉紅背景，只剩白血球的深紫色核；箭頭所指處是兩個淡色、長形略彎的小結構，中央有深色染色質或色素，形狀像新月形配子體，提示惡性瘧；影像放大倍率與清晰度有限。
features: Thick smear with lysed red cells forming a pale pink granular background
Scattered leukocyte nuclei (neutrophils/lymphocytes) as dense purple bodies
Two arrowed small elongated, slightly curved parasite forms with central dark chromatin/pigment
Shapes suggest crescentic gametocytes, but detail is limited by magnification and focus
No clearly identifiable ring forms or schizonts in this field
63449.describe_en: Thick blood film shows a background of lysed red cells with scattered leukocyte nuclei. Two small elongated, slightly curved forms with central dark chromatin and pigment are indicated by arrows, in keeping with crescentic gametocytes. Morphologic detail is limited at this magnification, and no ring forms are clearly identified in this field. Findings are suggestive of Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes; thick films are best for detection, and species identification should be confirmed on a thin film or by antigen/PCR testing.

ddx.dx: Platelets or platelet clumps on thick film
ddx.vs: Platelets appear as small purple granular clusters without an elongated shape, organized chromatin, or pigment.
On thick films P. vivax gametocytes are larger and round rather than crescentic, and ameboid trophozoites are usually present.
Debris is irregular and refractile at different focal planes without the consistent banana shape of gametocytes.

63385.recognize_zh: 左圖單核球（monocyte）灰藍色空泡化細胞質內含一顆被吞噬的紅血球，旁邊有一顆顆粒性白血球；右圖一個白血球被吞入的紅血球占滿，核被擠成新月形，這就是紅血球吞噬（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Left: monocyte with folded nucleus and vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm containing an intact engulfed red cell
Left: adjacent segmented granulocyte with pink cytoplasmic granules not involved in phagocytosis
Right: leukocyte distended by a single phagocytosed red cell, with nucleus compressed into a crescent at the periphery
Engulfed red cells retain hemoglobin color within a clear vacuole
Surrounding red cells and scattered platelets in the background
63385.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows erythrophagocytosis by circulating leukocytes. In the left panel, a monocyte with a folded nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm contains an engulfed red cell, adjacent to a granulocyte. In the right panel, a leukocyte is distended by a phagocytosed red cell that compresses its nucleus into a peripheral crescent. Findings are consistent with erythrophagocytosis, which suggests antibody- or complement-coated red cells and warrants a direct antiglobulin test and assessment for hemolysis.

ddx.vs: HLH shows hemophagocytosis by tissue histiocytes in marrow, spleen or liver along with clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides), not isolated circulating phagocytes.

ddx.dx: Overlapping red cell on a leukocyte
ddx.vs: An overlying red cell lies in a different plane without a surrounding clear vacuole or nuclear indentation.

ddx.dx: Signet ring-like cell with a large cytoplasmic vacuole
ddx.vs: An empty vacuole lacks the pink hemoglobin content of an engulfed red cell.
PCH also shows erythrophagocytosis by neutrophils, and it is distinguished by a positive Donath-Landsteiner test in a child after viral infection.

63321.recognize_zh: 中倍視野中央的嗜中性球（綠線）四周貼滿一圈紅血球形成玫瑰花狀（rosette），周圍多處紅血球重疊成不規則團塊（黃線，agglutination）；兩者並見提示紅血球表面有抗體或補體結合。
features: Segmented neutrophil encircled by a ring of adherent red cells (rosette, green line)
Multiple irregular red cell agglutinates scattered through the field (yellow lines)
Agglutinates are clustered rather than linear coin stacks
Occasional crenated red cells and scattered normal platelets
No nucleated red cells or schistocytes evident in this field
63321.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows multiple irregular red cell agglutinates and a central segmented neutrophil surrounded by a rosette of adherent red cells. Occasional crenated red cells and normal-appearing platelets are present; schistocytes and nucleated red cells are not seen in this field. Findings of red cell agglutination with rosetting around neutrophils are suggestive of immune-mediated hemolytic anemia with antibody- or complement-coated red cells, to be correlated with the direct antiglobulin test.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear coin stacks without rosetting and disperse on saline replacement.
Satellitism shows platelets, not red cells, ringing neutrophils and is an EDTA-dependent artifact.
Drying artifact produces uneven clumping in thick areas without circumferential red cell adherence to neutrophils.

63257.recognize_zh: 三格高倍周邊血影像中，嗜中性球的細胞質內各有一至兩個大而圓、界線清楚的透明空泡，將分葉核推擠變形，空泡內含淡粉紅色細顆粒物質；在脂肪栓塞的臨床背景下，這是吞噬脂肪球的嗜中性球，可用油紅 O 或 Sudan 染色證實。
features: Three high-power panels of neutrophils, each containing one or two large, round, sharply demarcated clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
Vacuoles are as large as or larger than the nucleus and indent and compress the segmented nucleus
Faint pink-purple granular material within the vacuoles
Neutrophil nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and irregular lobation
Background of crenated, clumped red cells (thick area, reduced image clarity)
63257.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear images show neutrophils containing one to two large, round, well-demarcated clear intracytoplasmic vacuoles that indent and distort the segmented nuclei. The vacuoles contain faint pink granular material, and the surrounding red cells are crenated and clumped. These are distinct from the small, multiple vacuoles of toxic change. In a patient with suspected fat embolism and fat particles in the collection tube, the findings are consistent with neutrophils containing phagocytosed fat globules; confirmation with a fat stain (Oil red O or Sudan black) on an unfixed smear is recommended.

ddx.vs: Toxic vacuoles are small, multiple and irregular, often with toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, rather than one or two large round vacuoles that deform the nucleus.
Prolonged storage produces small uniform vacuoles in many neutrophils and monocytes, not large fat globules, and resolves on a fresh sample.
Organisms appear as defined yeast forms with a halo or as basophilic rods/cocci within the cytoplasm, rather than empty clear vacuoles that stain with fat stains.
Jordans anomaly shows constitutional lipid vacuoles in most neutrophils and monocytes of all smears, not an acute finding tied to fat embolism.

63193.recognize_zh: 視野中絕大多數紅血球中央淡染區都呈狹長裂隙（口形紅血球，stomatocyte）；中央偏右、箭頭左側有一顆與紅血球等大、布滿紫色細顆粒的巨大血小板，口形紅血球加巨大血小板要想到植物固醇血症（sitosterolemia）。
features: Majority of red cells are stomatocytes with a single elongated slit-like central pallor
Giant platelet left of the arrow, comparable in size to a red cell, with evenly distributed purple granules
Few round discocytes with normal central pallor; occasional larger, irregular cells
Very few normal-sized platelets in the field
No schistocytes, spherocytes or nucleated red cells
63193.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of stomatocytes, most red cells having a single elongated slit-like central pallor, with only a few round discocytes. A giant platelet comparable in size to a red cell, with evenly distributed purple granules, is present to the left of the arrow, and normal-sized platelets are sparse in this field. Schistocytes, spherocytes and nucleated red cells are not seen. The combination of prominent stomatocytosis and macrothrombocytes suggests sitosterolemia or a hereditary stomatocytosis syndrome, and correlation with platelet count, plasma plant sterols and red cell indices is recommended. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis with giant platelets.

ddx.vs: Artifactual slits are limited to thick areas, whereas this population is present across a thin monolayer with well-separated cells.
Giant platelets are present but red cells lack stomatocytosis; MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions.
Shares stomatocytes but typically has normal-sized platelets, with hemolysis and abnormal cation flux on specialized testing.

63129.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一顆大型組織球，淡染細胞質內包含多顆完整的小淋巴球，周圍有空暈（emperipolesis），背景有漿細胞與淋巴球浸潤於纖維性基質中，為 Rosai-Dorfman 病的特徵。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale cytoplasm containing multiple intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis, arrow)
Engulfed lymphocytes surrounded by clear halos within the histiocyte cytoplasm
Other histiocytes with vesicular nuclei, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Plasma cells and small lymphocytes in background
Fibrous, loosely collagenous stroma
63129.describe_en: High-power sections show large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm in a fibrous stroma with admixed plasma cells and lymphocytes. One histiocyte contains numerous intact lymphocytes within its cytoplasm, each surrounded by a clear halo (emperipolesis, arrow). The engulfed cells appear viable without evidence of degradation. Findings are characteristic of Rosai-Dorfman disease, here in an extranodal site.

ddx.vs: HLH macrophages show true phagocytosis with degraded cells and are S100 negative, whereas emperipolesis in RDD preserves intact lymphocytes in S100+ histiocytes.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei, eosinophil-rich background, and CD1a/langerin positivity without emperipolesis.
Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact lymphocytes and are S100 negative.

63065.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片見許多體積很小、深染且無中央淡染區的小球形紅血球（microspherocytes），並有少數鋸齒狀紅血球；這些微小球形細胞在阻抗法血球計數時可能被誤算為血小板，造成血小板數假性偏高。
features: Numerous microspherocytes: small, dense, round red cells without central pallor
Background normocytic red cells with central pallor
Scattered crenated red cells (echinocytes)
Few small purple particles consistent with platelets or debris
No definite schistocytes or nucleated red cells in this field
63065.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous microspherocytes, which are small, densely staining round red cells lacking central pallor, admixed with normocytic red cells and occasional crenated cells. Definite schistocytes are not identified in this field. In the setting of a scorpion sting with DIC, the microspherocytes are compatible with venom-induced red cell membrane injury and hemolysis. Because microspherocytes may be counted as platelets by impedance analyzers, the platelet count should be verified by smear review or an optical or immunologic method.

ddx.vs: HS spherocytes are less uniformly minute, with a chronic history, positive family history and reduced EMA binding.
AIHA spherocytes are accompanied by a positive direct antiglobulin test and often polychromasia.
These also cause microspherocytes but are distinguished by history (burn injury, clostridial infection) rather than morphology.
MAHA/DIC classically shows schistocytes (helmet cells, fragments), which are not prominent in this field.

63001.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色（reticulin）中，左側與中央區域有大量粗細不一、交織成網並有局部粗纖維束的黑色纖維（相當於 MF-2 至 MF-3），對應肥大細胞浸潤區；右側殘存的正常骨髓則只有稀疏的細纖維。以同一視野比較病灶區與正常區，是判讀纖維化分級的關鍵。
features: Dense, diffuse network of intersecting black reticulin fibers with focal thick bundles in the lesional area (left and center)
Fibers run in parallel streaming arrays around spindled infiltrate cells
Adjacent residual marrow (right) with only sparse fine reticulin fibers
Bony trabecula and vessel wall at the edges for orientation
Grade approximately MF-2 to MF-3 in the infiltrate versus MF-0/1 in residual marrow
63001.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section stained for reticulin shows a lesional area with a dense, diffuse network of intersecting reticulin fibers with focal coarse bundles, corresponding to MF-2 to MF-3 fibrosis. The fibers stream around spindled cells of the infiltrate. The adjacent residual hematopoietic marrow on the right shows only sparse fine fibers, within normal limits. Findings are consistent with marked reticulin fibrosis associated with a mast cell infiltrate in systemic mastocytosis; the stated 400x objective appears higher than the actual magnification of this image.

ddx.vs: PMF fibrosis is diffuse and accompanied by clustered atypical megakaryocytes, whereas mastocytosis fibrosis is focal and confined to tryptase/CD117-positive spindle cell aggregates.
HCL shows diffuse fine reticulin fibrosis around evenly spaced fried-egg lymphoid cells that are CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive.
Metastatic tumor produces focal fibrosis around cohesive keratin-positive epithelial nests rather than spindled mast cells.
Reparative fibrosis contains granulation tissue, new bone and hemosiderin without a neoplastic infiltrate.

62937.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質內有數顆大小不一、形狀不規則的深洋紅至紫色巨大顆粒（giant granules），明顯大於正常嗜中性顆粒，這是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的特徵性包涵體。
features: Segmented neutrophil with multiple large, irregular, deep magenta-purple cytoplasmic granules
Giant granules vary in size, several approaching the size of a nuclear lobe fragment
Remaining cytoplasm pale with few normal-sized granules
Surrounding red cells normocytic and normochromic
Image resolution is somewhat limited, with mild blur
62937.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a segmented neutrophil containing multiple large, irregular, deep magenta-purple cytoplasmic granules that are strikingly larger than normal neutrophilic granules. The background cytoplasm is otherwise pale. Surrounding red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Image resolution is modest, but the granule size is clearly abnormal. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, uniform, dark purple azurophilic granules evenly distributed throughout the cytoplasm, not a few giant irregular inclusions.
Alder-Reilly granules are coarse and dark but uniform and diffuse, and they occur in all leukocytes in mucopolysaccharidoses without giant fused granules.
These are pale blue cytoplasmic inclusions, not magenta-purple granules, and May-Hegglin has giant platelets.
Pseudo-CH granules occur in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid cells in adults with blasts or dysplasia, not in an otherwise normal hemogram.

62873.recognize_zh: 大腸內視鏡影像可見多發性、表面平滑紅色的隆起結節與息肉樣病灶，部分表面有小糜爛或黃白色覆蓋物，腸腔尚通暢；多發息肉樣黏膜病灶是腸道惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病的常見內視鏡表現之一，但無特異性。
features: Multiple sessile, smooth-surfaced nodular and polypoid mucosal elevations
Some nodules show small superficial erosions with yellow-white exudate
A discrete sessile polyp in the lower panel with lobulated surface
Lumen patent without circumferential stricture or large ulcerated mass
62873.describe_en: Colonoscopic images (2014) show multiple sessile, smooth-surfaced nodular and polypoid elevations of the colonic mucosa, some with small superficial erosions covered by yellow-white exudate, and a separate lobulated sessile polyp. The lumen remains patent without a large ulcerated or stricturing mass. The endoscopic appearance is nonspecific; the multinodular pattern raises lymphomatous involvement, and biopsy with immunophenotyping is required. In this case, the findings correspond to mucosal involvement by indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the gastrointestinal tract.

ddx.vs: Endoscopically similar, but biopsy shows CD20, CD5 and cyclin D1-positive B cells rather than a CD3/CD8-positive T-cell infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma of the GI tract
ddx.vs: Biopsy shows neoplastic follicles of CD10 and BCL2-positive B cells.
Histology shows dysplastic or serrated epithelium rather than lamina propria expansion by lymphocytes.
Background mucosa shows chronic active colitis with architectural distortion, and the infiltrate is polyclonal.

62809.recognize_zh: 黏膜潰瘍下方有一片深層浸潤：大型不典型單核細胞（核空泡狀、核仁明顯）夾雜許多嗜酸性球，大細胞CD30陽性，背景T細胞混雜，TCR-γ基因重組片段分布偏多株性，符合創傷性潰瘍性肉芽腫合併間質嗜酸性球增多（TUGSE）。
features: Ulcerated mucosal biopsy with a dense, deep polymorphous infiltrate at low power (A)
Large atypical mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, admixed with numerous eosinophils and small lymphocytes (B)
Scattered large cells with membranous/Golgi CD30 positivity (C)
CD3 and CD2 highlight a mixed T-cell population; arrows mark large cells with variable staining (D, E)
TCR gamma PCR (Vγ10, Vγ1-8, Vγ9) shows multiple peaks in a largely polyclonal distribution (F)
62809.describe_en: Mucosal biopsy shows surface ulceration overlying a dense, deeply extending polymorphous inflammatory infiltrate. At high power, the infiltrate consists of large atypical mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, admixed with abundant eosinophils and small lymphocytes. The large cells are CD30 positive, and CD3 and CD2 stain a mixed T-cell population with variable expression in the large cells (arrows). T-cell receptor gamma gene rearrangement studies show multiple peaks without a single dominant clonal product in this panel. Findings are consistent with traumatic ulcerative granuloma with stromal eosinophilia (TUGSE), a reactive CD30-positive lymphoproliferation of the oral mucosa.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous/mucosal CD30-positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder (ALCL)
ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of cohesive hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30, frequent loss of pan-T antigens and a dominant clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike the polymorphous, self-limited TUGSE lesion.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15+/PAX5 weak and CD3/CD2 negative and occur in a nodal rather than ulcerated oral mucosal setting.
LCH cells have grooved reniform nuclei and express CD1a, S100 and langerin, not CD30.
PTCL shows a monotonous atypical infiltrate with clonal TCR gene rearrangement rather than a mixed, eosinophil-rich reactive background.

62809.stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD3, CD2; TCR-γ PCR

62745.recognize_zh: 組織中成片中大型漿細胞樣細胞，核呈泡狀並有明顯核仁；CD79a、CD138 與 IgG 陽性，但 kappa 與 lambda 輕鏈都呈陰性，免疫固定電泳只見 IgG（G）條帶而無對應輕鏈，符合 γ 重鏈病。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium to large plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval vesicular nuclei, many with a distinct central nucleolus
IHC: CD79a and CD138 positive with cytoplasmic IgG expression
IHC: tumor cells negative for both kappa and lambda light chains (only rare positive reactive cell)
Immunofixation: band in the gamma lane without a matching kappa or lambda band
62745.describe_en: Tissue sections show a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large plasmacytoid cells with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei containing distinct nucleoli. The neoplastic cells express CD79a, CD138, and cytoplasmic IgG, but are negative for both kappa and lambda light chains, with only rare scattered positive reactive cells. Serum immunofixation electrophoresis shows a monoclonal band in the IgG lane without a corresponding kappa or lambda light chain band. Findings are consistent with gamma heavy chain disease with a plasmacytic neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma or plasmacytoma (IgG type)
ddx.vs: Conventional IgG myeloma shows monotypic kappa or lambda light chain co-expression and a matching light chain band on immunofixation.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has immunoblastic cells with very high proliferation and frequent EBER positivity, and usually expresses a light chain.
LPL comprises small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than a sheet of IgG-only plasmacytoid cells.
Non-secretory neoplasms lack both heavy and light chain secretion, whereas here an isolated gamma heavy chain band is detected.

62745.stain: H&E; IHC: CD79a, CD138, IgG, kappa, lambda; IFE

62681.recognize_zh: 極低倍下整個淋巴結被一致的淋巴細胞浸潤取代，隱約可見大小相近、邊界模糊的結節輪廓；下方的淋巴細胞穿出被膜進入周圍脂肪組織，形成小結節。
features: Scanning power: lymph node diffusely replaced by lymphoid infiltrate with vague, closely packed nodules of similar size
Nodules poorly delineated with attenuated/absent mantle zones
Thin capsule at lower edge with lymphoid aggregates extending into perinodal adipose tissue
No obvious preserved sinuses or normal nodal compartments
Hemorrhage in perinodal tissue at lower right corner
62681.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows effacement of the normal architecture by a lymphoid infiltrate forming vague, closely packed nodules of relatively uniform size without well-formed mantle zones. The subcapsular sinus is not apparent, and lymphoid aggregates extend through the capsule into the perinodal adipose tissue. No normal sinuses or reactive follicles are evident at this magnification. The pattern is consistent with follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by CD10, BCL6, BCL2 and CD21 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have polarized germinal centers with tingible body macrophages and mantle zones, and do not extend into perinodal fat.
NLPHL nodules are larger and contain scattered LP (popcorn) cells in a small B-cell background, identified at higher power and by CD20/OCT2 positivity.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells that are cyclin D1 positive, lacking centroblasts.

62617.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交：積液細胞塊中約一半的大型腫瘤細胞核呈棕色陽性訊號，其餘細胞核為藍色（陰性）；PEL 多數同時帶有 HHV8 與 EBV（尤其 HIV 病人），EBER 陽性支持診斷但 HHV8 才是必要條件。
features: Nuclear brown EBER signal in roughly half of the large atypical cells
Variable signal intensity from strong to weak among positive nuclei
Negative cells show blue hematoxylin counterstained nuclei
Positive cells are large, discohesive and arranged in a loose cluster
Clean background without non-specific cytoplasmic staining
62617.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded small RNA (EBER) on the effusion cell block shows nuclear positivity in a substantial subset, approximately half, of the large atypical lymphoid cells, with variable signal intensity; the remaining cells are negative. There is no non-specific background staining. Most primary effusion lymphomas, particularly in HIV-positive patients, are dually infected by KSHV/HHV8 and EBV. The findings support the diagnosis of EBV-positive primary effusion lymphoma, provided HHV8 LANA-1 positivity is also demonstrated.

ddx.vs: Fibrin-associated DLBCL is also EBER positive but is HHV8 LANA-1 negative, expresses B-cell markers and arises in chronic fibrin deposits.
EBV+ DLBCL forms tissue masses, expresses CD20/PAX5 and lacks HHV8, unlike the effusion-based HHV8+ null-phenotype PEL.

ddx.dx: Pyothorax-associated lymphoma (DLBCL associated with chronic inflammation)
ddx.vs: It arises after long-standing pyothorax as a pleural mass, is EBV+ B-cell lineage and HHV8 negative.

62553.recognize_zh: c-MYC 蛋白在大多數腫瘤細胞核呈中到強度陽性，估計遠超過 40%，只有少數細胞核為藍色陰性；MYC 高表現提示需進行 FISH 檢查 MYC 重排，但蛋白表現不等於基因重排。
features: Nuclear MYC staining of moderate to strong intensity in the large majority of tumor cells (well above 40%)
Minority of blue unstained nuclei, including small background cells and endothelial cells
Medium to large nuclei with round to oval contours arranged in diffuse sheets
Blood vessels with erythrocytes serve as internal negative structures
62553.describe_en: MYC immunohistochemistry shows moderate to strong nuclear staining in the large majority of neoplastic cells, visually well above the 40% threshold used to define MYC protein overexpression, with only a minority of unstained nuclei. The positive cells form diffuse sheets around small vessels. High MYC protein expression, particularly when combined with BCL2 expression, defines a double-expressor phenotype and should prompt FISH; in this case FISH confirmed MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Double-expressor lymphomas show MYC (40% or more) and BCL2 (50% or more) protein by IHC but lack gene rearrangements on FISH.
Burkitt shows near-100% MYC nuclear staining with BCL2 negativity.
Most DLBCL, NOS show MYC in a smaller fraction of cells below 40%.

62425.recognize_zh: 這是反向移位 PCR（inverse shift PCR）的洋菜膠電泳圖：F8 內含子 22 倒位（Inv22）產生約 559 bp 產物，正常等位基因約 487 bp；看每條泳道是單一 559、單一 487，還是兩者皆有，就能判斷患者、正常人或帶因母親，用於 A 型血友病（hemophilia A）的基因診斷與產前診斷。
features: 2% agarose gel with 7 lanes; lane 2 is a DNA size ladder with bright 500 bp band
Lane 1 (Inv22 positive control): single band at ~559 bp
Lane 3 (mother): dominant ~487 bp band plus a fainter ~559 bp band, indicating heterozygosity
Lane 4 (normal): single band at ~487 bp
Lanes 5 and 6 (index case and chorionic villus sample): single ~559 bp band (Inv22 positive)
Lane 7: single ~487 bp band (unlabelled in legend, presumably normal control)
62425.describe_en: Agarose gel electrophoresis of inverse shift PCR products for the factor VIII intron 22 inversion is shown with a size ladder in lane 2. The positive control (lane 1), the index case (lane 5) and the chorionic villus sample (lane 6) show a single ~559 bp product indicative of the inversion, whereas the normal sample (lane 4) and lane 7 show the ~487 bp wild-type product. The mother (lane 3) shows both wild-type and inversion-associated products, consistent with a heterozygous carrier; lane 3 also has additional faint upper bands. The legend lists six lanes while seven are visible, so lane 7 assignment should be confirmed. Findings are consistent with an inherited F8 intron 22 inversion (severe hemophilia A) in the index case and an affected fetus.

ddx.vs: Intron 1 inversion is detected by a different primer set and would give a wild-type result on intron 22 IS-PCR.

ddx.dx: F8 point mutation or small deletion
ddx.vs: Non-inversion variants give a normal IS-PCR pattern and require F8 sequencing.
Low FVIII from impaired VWF binding is excluded by VWF:FVIIIB assay and VWF gene testing, not by F8 inversion studies.

62361.recognize_zh: 大部分腫瘤細胞核呈棕色 TdT 陽性，只有散在的小型內皮或間質細胞核仍為藍色，證實這些細胞為淋巴母細胞（前驅細胞）而非成熟淋巴球。
features: Diffuse nuclear TdT positivity in the majority of tumor cells
Tumor nuclei are oval to spindled/irregular with variable staining intensity
Scattered negative (blue) nuclei representing endothelial and stromal cells
Some diffuse cytoplasmic/background brown staining, but the specific signal is nuclear
62361.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for TdT shows nuclear positivity in the large majority of the infiltrating tumor cells, with variable intensity, while scattered endothelial and stromal nuclei are negative. Mild nonspecific background cytoplasmic staining is present. Nuclear TdT expression establishes the precursor (lymphoblastic) nature of the neoplasm and, with CD3 positivity, supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: B-LBL is also TdT+ but expresses CD19, CD79a and PAX5 and lacks CD3.

ddx.dx: Thymoma with TdT+ immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymomas contain TdT+ cortical thymocytes admixed with a keratin-positive epithelial meshwork, which is absent in lymphoblastic lymphoma.
Burkitt lymphoma is TdT-negative, CD10+ BCL6+ with a near-100% Ki-67 index and MYC rearrangement.
Some AML is TdT+ but expresses MPO, lysozyme or CD117 and lacks cytoplasmic CD3.

62297.recognize_zh: 這是一袋紅血球血品的外觀照片：袋內與管路中的血液呈鮮亮的櫻桃紅色，而非一般較暗的深紅色，照片上看不到分層或溶血跡象；鑑別需考慮溶血、動脈血採集、低血比容與一氧化碳中毒，本例歸因於捐血者血比容偏低。
features: Gross photograph of a blood component bag containing packed red cells
Uniform bright cherry-red coloration of the bag contents and attached segment tubing
No visible clots, clumps, air or layering in the bag
Supernatant clarity cannot be assessed without centrifugation of a segment
Intact bag seams and ports without leakage
62297.describe_en: The image is a gross photograph of a red cell component bag whose contents and attached segment tubing show a uniform bright cherry-red color rather than the usual darker red. No clots, visible layering or leakage are identified, although the presence or absence of hemolysis cannot be judged from the bag alone and requires inspection of the supernatant after centrifugation of a segment. The differential for a cherry-red unit includes hemolysis, arterial collection, low donor hematocrit and carbon monoxide exposure. In this case, a clear supernatant, a non-pulsatile collection and a donor hematocrit of 37.1% support a lower hematocrit as the most likely cause.

ddx.vs: Hemolysis produces a red to pink supernatant after segment centrifugation, whereas here the supernatant was clear.
Arterial collection is suggested by rapid, pulsatile filling during donation and a high oxygen saturation of the unit.
Carboxyhemoglobin gives a cherry-red color and is confirmed by CO-oximetry showing elevated COHb, typically in heavy smokers or exposure victims.
Contaminated units usually appear darker purple or show clots, hemolysis or gas, with discordant segment and bag color, confirmed by Gram stain and culture.

62105.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓切片的骨小樑之間塞滿灰白色、呈放射狀星芒排列的針狀結晶，外圍有密集紅染的纖維及梭形細胞，造血組織幾乎不見，指向骨髓草酸鹽沉積（oxalosis）。
features: Bone marrow core with trabecular bone at the lower left and edges
Intertrabecular space filled with gray-white needle-shaped crystals in stellate/radiating clusters
Dense surrounding fibrous tissue with spindle cells and probable foreign-body reaction
Marked depletion of hematopoietic tissue and fat
Low-resolution image limits cytologic detail
62105.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy at low power shows the intertrabecular marrow largely replaced by gray-white, needle-shaped crystals arranged in stellate and radiating clusters, embedded in dense eosinophilic fibrous tissue with spindle cells.
