Normal hematopoietic tissue and marrow fat are markedly reduced in the involved area. The image resolution limits evaluation of individual cells. Findings are consistent with marrow oxalosis, which should prompt evaluation for primary hyperoxaluria or secondary hyperoxalosis in renal failure.

ddx.vs: Metastatic deposits contain cohesive atypical epithelial cells confirmable with keratin immunostains rather than acellular crystal rosettes.

ddx.dx: Fibrotic marrow in myelofibrosis or renal osteodystrophy
ddx.vs: These show fibrosis and trabecular remodeling but lack extracellular refractile crystalline sheaves that polarize.
Tophi show amorphous pale material with a palisading histiocytic rim, as urate crystals dissolve in routine processing unlike persistent oxalate rosettes.

62041.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中只有散在的大型細胞呈顆粒狀細胞質陽性，細胞核大而淡、呈空泡狀，周圍的小淋巴球全為陰性；這些孤立的大型陽性細胞代表 NLPHL 背景中的 LP 細胞。
features: Scattered large cells with granular cytoplasmic and perinuclear DAB staining
Positive cells have large, pale, vesicular nuclei, some irregular in contour
Positive cells are widely spaced, not forming clusters or sheets
Background of dense small round negative lymphocytes
Occasional faint granular staining in small cells/histiocytes
62041.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; antigen not labeled) of a lymph node shows scattered large cells with granular cytoplasmic and perinuclear staining in a dense background of negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells have large vesicular nuclei and are individually dispersed without sheet formation. The findings highlight scattered large atypical cells consistent with LP cells of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; the specific marker (e.g., EMA or another LP-cell marker) should be confirmed in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: HRS cells show CD30 and CD15 membranous plus Golgi staining with weak/absent CD20, whereas LP cells are CD30/CD15 negative with strong B-cell program markers.
Architecture (absence of nodules and CD21+ FDC meshworks) rather than the single-cell immunophenotype separates THRLBCL from NLPHL.
Reactive immunoblasts are polymorphous, often interfollicular, and lack the LP-cell nuclear lobation and consistent rosetting by PD1+ T cells.

61977.recognize_zh: 皮膚病灶的 TCRβ（βF1）免疫染色中，真皮內密集的小到中型淋巴球絕大多數呈細胞膜及細胞質棕色陽性，只剩少數藍色未染色細胞；表示浸潤細胞為 αβ T 細胞，保留 TCRβ 表現，符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病。
features: Dense dermal infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic βF1 (TCR beta) staining in the large majority of cells
Scattered unstained cells (histiocytes, B cells, stromal cells) interspersed
Delicate collagen and small vessels traverse the infiltrate
No large atypical cell population evident on this stain
61977.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for TCR beta (βF1) on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells, the large majority of which are strongly positive with membranous and cytoplasmic staining. Scattered unstained cells and fine collagen bundles are interspersed. Retained TCR beta expression indicates an alpha-beta T-cell population. In conjunction with a CD4-predominant phenotype and few large cells, the findings are consistent with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: Gamma-delta T-cell lymphoma is βF1-negative and TCR delta-positive, typically CD4/CD8 double-negative and cytotoxic, with panniculitic or epidermal involvement and an aggressive course.
Mycosis fungoides is also αβ CD4+ but has a history of patches and plaques with epidermotropism and often large-cell transformation, rather than a solitary nodule of small/medium cells.
Pseudolymphoma also contains βF1+ T cells but shows a polyclonal mixed infiltrate with preserved pan-T antigens and no dominant PD-1+ medium-sized cells.

61913.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一個巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿數十個大小一致、約2–3 μm的卵圓形小體，並有許多散落在細胞外的同樣小體，符合利什曼原蟲（Leishmania）無鞭毛體；此圖稍失焦，動基體（kinetoplast）不易辨認。
features: Large macrophage whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous uniform small oval bodies (about 2-3 μm) arranged around its nucleus
Similar organisms scattered extracellularly in the background, likely released from ruptured macrophages
Each organism shows a small purple nucleus; the rod-shaped kinetoplast is not clearly resolved because the image is slightly out of focus
Surrounding marrow cells include maturing myeloid precursors and erythroid cells
No surrounding clear halo or capsule around the organisms
61913.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage distended by numerous uniform, small oval intracellular organisms measuring approximately 2-3 μm, with additional organisms lying free in the background. The organisms have a small nucleus; a paranuclear bar-shaped kinetoplast is not well resolved at this focus, and there is no halo or capsule. The surrounding hematopoietic cells show maturing myeloid and erythroid elements. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (visceral leishmaniasis); confirmation of the kinetoplast at higher power, culture or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are similar in size but have a clear halo (retracted cell wall), no kinetoplast, and stain with GMS/PAS, whereas Leishmania amastigotes have a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and are GMS-negative.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and are GMS-positive, lacking a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.

ddx.dx: Platelets or phagocytosed debris overlying a macrophage
ddx.vs: Platelets are irregular granular fragments without an organized nucleus and kinetoplast and are not uniform in shape.

61849.recognize_zh: 高倍下腫瘤細胞有中量淡嗜伊紅細胞質，核卵圓至腎形、明顯核溝與折疊（咖啡豆樣），染色質細緻；這是蘭格漢斯樣樹突細胞的核型，但缺乏嗜伊紅球，需靠 Langerin 陰性判定為不定型樹突細胞腫瘤。
features: Medium-to-large histiocytoid cells with moderate pale eosinophilic, finely granular cytoplasm
Oval to reniform nuclei with prominent grooves, folds, and indentations (coffee-bean-like)
Fine, vesicular chromatin with thin nuclear membranes and small nucleoli
Mild to moderate nuclear pleomorphism with occasional hyperchromatic cells
Cohesive sheets without conspicuous eosinophils
61849.describe_en: High-power view shows sheets of medium-to-large histiocytoid cells with moderate amounts of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei exhibiting prominent grooves, folds, and indentations, with fine vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli. There is mild to moderate nuclear pleomorphism, and eosinophils are not conspicuous in this field. The cytology is that of a Langerhans-type dendritic cell; with CD1a and S100 positivity and Langerin negativity, findings are consistent with indeterminate dendritic cell tumor.

ddx.vs: LCH shows identical grooved nuclei, usually with abundant eosinophils, and is distinguished by Langerin (CD207) positivity.
LC sarcoma has overtly malignant cytology with marked pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and high mitotic rate while retaining CD1a/Langerin.
Histiocytic sarcoma cells are larger with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, express CD163/PU.1, and lack CD1a.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe nuclei with a paranuclear eosinophilic Golgi zone and are CD30+ and ALK or T-cell marker positive.

61785.recognize_zh: 這是 G-banding 核型圖：第 7 號只剩一條（圈起），第 9 號其中一條長臂末端外觀不同、第 22 號其中一條明顯變短（Philadelphia chromosome），合計 45 條，對應 -7 合併 t(9;22)。
features: GTG-banded karyogram arranged by ISCN order with circled abnormalities
Single chromosome 7 (monosomy 7), giving a total count of 45
Chromosome 9 pair circled: one homolog with altered distal 9q banding, consistent with der(9)t(9;22)
Chromosome 22 pair circled: one homolog visibly shortened, consistent with the Philadelphia chromosome der(22)t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
Two chromosomes in the X position with the Y position empty/faded, although the text karyotype reads XY
Moderate band resolution; fine breakpoints cannot be independently confirmed at this image resolution
61785.describe_en: G-banded karyogram from an unstimulated bone marrow aspirate culture shows 45 chromosomes. There is a single chromosome 7 (monosomy 7) and a balanced reciprocal translocation between 9q34 and 22q11.2, with a visibly shortened derivative chromosome 22 (Philadelphia chromosome) and an altered derivative chromosome 9. The image appears to show two X chromosomes and no Y, which fits the stated female patient; the written karyotype 45,XY,-7,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)[20] likely contains a sex-chromosome typographical error. In a CD10-positive B-lymphoblastic leukemia, these findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with BCR::ABL1 and additional monosomy 7, both adverse features; note that a modal number of 45 is near-diploid and should not be confused with true hypodiploid ALL (<44 chromosomes).

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in lymphoid blast phase
ddx.vs: Carries the same t(9;22), so separation relies on clinical history, absence of a preceding chronic phase, basophilia/splenomegaly, and BCR::ABL1 transcript type (p210 favors CML, p190 favors de novo Ph+ ALL).
Shares a kinase-activated gene expression profile but lacks a cytogenetically visible Philadelphia chromosome and BCR::ABL1 fusion by FISH/RT-PCR.
Defined by fewer than 44 chromosomes with multiple whole-chromosome losses, whereas this karyogram has 45 chromosomes with a single monosomy plus a structural translocation.
Involves a third chromosome in the rearrangement, which would be seen as an additional abnormal homolog and confirmed by BCR::ABL1 FISH.

61721.recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 CD34 對 CD19 流式圖：綠色異常芽細胞群 CD34 陰性、CD19 陰性，與右側紅色 CD34 陽性的正常前驅細胞分開，藍色少量為 CD19 陽性 B 細胞；BPDCN 芽細胞典型上不表現 CD34 及 B 細胞標記。
features: Dot plot: CD34-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD19-APC700 (y-axis), gated on blasts
Abnormal population (green) negative for CD34 and CD19
Discrete CD34-bright/CD19-negative normal progenitor population (red)
Small CD19-positive/CD34-negative B-cell cluster (blue) as internal control
No CD34+/CD19+ hematogone population evident
61721.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of CD34 versus CD19 gated on blasts shows that the abnormal population (green) is negative for both CD34 and CD19. A separate CD34-bright population of residual normal progenitors (red) and a small CD19-positive mature B-cell cluster (blue) serve as internal controls. The absence of CD34 and B-lineage antigens on the abnormal blasts argues against B-lymphoblastic leukemia and most CD34-positive AMLs. This negative profile is compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when combined with CD4, CD56 and CD123 positivity.

ddx.vs: B-ALL blasts are CD19-positive with CD10/CD22/TdT and frequently CD34-positive, unlike this CD19-negative population.
CD34-negative AML still expresses myeloid (CD13/CD33/CD117) or monocytic (CD64/CD14/CD36) markers rather than a CD4+/CD56+/CD123-bright phenotype.

61657.recognize_zh: 血片中紅血球非常擁擠、彼此重疊，形態大致正常，並可見數顆成熟分葉嗜中性球與一小團血小板聚集；紅血球擁擠提示血球容積升高，但本身不具特異性，需結合 JAK2 突變等資料才能判定真性紅血球增多症。
features: Densely crowded, overlapping normocytic normochromic red cells with little free background
Several mature segmented neutrophils without toxic change or dysplasia
Two mononuclear cells with irregular elongated shapes distorted by the crowded red cells (upper centre and upper right)
Small platelet clump at top centre and scattered single platelets
No nucleated red cells, blasts or teardrop cells in this field
61657.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows densely packed, overlapping red cells that are predominantly normocytic and normochromic, suggestive of an increased hematocrit. Mature segmented neutrophils are present without toxic or dysplastic changes, along with occasional mononuclear cells distorted by the crowded red cells. Platelets are present singly and in a small clump. No blasts, nucleated red cells or teardrop cells are identified. These nonspecific findings are compatible with polycythemia vera in the appropriate clinical and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, so separation requires ancillary data: secondary erythrocytosis has normal or high erythropoietin, no JAK2 mutation and usually no leukocytosis or thrombocytosis.
Relative polycythemia shows comparable red cell crowding but normal red cell mass and no JAK2 mutation, and normalizes after rehydration.

ddx.dx: Thick area of a normal smear
ddx.vs: A thick smear region shows similar red cell overlap artifactually, so the monolayer area and measured hemoglobin/hematocrit must be reviewed before interpreting crowding as erythrocytosis.

61593.recognize_zh: 兩個嗜中性球（上方為帶狀/後骨髓球樣核）的細胞質內顆粒增粗增多（中毒性顆粒），並可見淡灰藍色的細胞質斑塊（Döhle 小體）；背景血小板極少。這些改變配合近期使用 G-CSF 的病史，符合生長因子治療效應。
features: Neutrophils with increased coarse purple cytoplasmic granulation (toxic-type granulation)
Pale blue-gray cytoplasmic patches consistent with Dohle bodies
Upper cell with band/metamyelocyte-like indented nucleus, suggesting left shift
Lower cell with band-shaped nucleus and similar coarse granules
Platelets essentially absent in the field; red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional ovalocytes
61593.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophilic granulocytes, one with a band/metamyelocyte-like indented nucleus and one with a band-shaped nucleus. Both show increased coarse purple cytoplasmic granulation and pale blue-gray cytoplasmic patches consistent with Dohle bodies. Platelets are virtually absent in the field, and red cells show mild anisocytosis. In a post-transplant patient recently treated with G-CSF, these findings are consistent with growth factor effect; similar changes may be seen with infection (toxic change), so clinical correlation is required.

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation, Dohle bodies and vacuolization are morphologically identical, so the distinction depends on the history of G-CSF administration versus clinical infection.
MYH9 disorders show larger, more spindle-shaped Dohle-like inclusions in all granulocytes with giant platelets and no toxic granulation.
Alder-Reilly granules are large, dark and present in all leukocytes including lymphocytes, without Dohle bodies.
Chediak-Higashi shows giant, discrete peroxidase-positive granules rather than diffuse fine-to-coarse toxic granulation.

61529.recognize_zh: 十二指腸黏膜固有層被密集淋巴細胞結節撐開，這群細胞 BCL2 呈瀰漫強陽性（包括結節中心），而上皮細胞為陰性；濾泡樣結節內 BCL2 陽性代表非反應性生發中心，符合濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Dense nodular lymphoid infiltrate expanding the duodenal lamina propria and villous cores
Diffuse, strong cytoplasmic/membranous BCL2 staining throughout the nodule, including its center
Villous and crypt epithelium BCL2 negative
Lymphoid cells surround and separate crypts without destroying them in this field
61529.describe_en: Duodenal mucosal biopsy stained for BCL2 shows a dense nodular lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and extending into villous cores. The lymphoid cells, including those within the follicle-like nodule, show diffuse and strong BCL2 positivity, whereas the surface and crypt epithelium is negative. Aberrant BCL2 expression within follicle-center cells distinguishes this infiltrate from reactive germinal centers. Together with CD10 and BCL6 expression, findings are consistent with duodenal-type follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal center B cells are BCL2 negative, with BCL2 limited to mantle zone B cells and T cells.
MALT lymphoma is also BCL2 positive but lacks CD10 and BCL6 and shows lymphoepithelial lesions and monocytoid or plasmacytic cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is BCL2 positive but CD5+, cyclin D1+, SOX11+, and CD10 negative.

61465.recognize_zh: 四格圖：A 周邊血可見高核質比的中型芽細胞；B 軟組織切片為瀰漫成片的小至中型圓形藍色腫瘤細胞；C 免疫染色腫瘤細胞呈細胞質顆粒狀陽性、插圖中另一標記為陰性（提示轉為骨髓／單核球系表現）；D FISH 分離探針出現紅綠訊號分開，代表 KMT2A 重排，符合 blinatumomab 後髓外復發並發生系列轉換。
features: Panel A (PB): intermediate-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, dense-appearing chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Panel B (H&E, extramedullary tissue): diffuse sheets of small-to-medium round blue cells infiltrating between collagen strands
Panel C (IHC): granular cytoplasmic positivity in most tumor cells; inset marker negative (specific antibodies not labeled in the figure)
Panel D (interphase FISH, break-apart probe): one fused red-green signal plus separated red and green signals, indicating KMT2A rearrangement
Low image resolution limits nuclear detail and lineage assignment by morphology alone
61465.describe_en: This composite figure shows (A) a peripheral blood smear with intermediate-sized blasts having high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and (B) an extramedullary tissue biopsy diffusely infiltrated by sheets of small-to-medium round blue cells. (C) Immunohistochemistry shows granular cytoplasmic staining in the tumor cells with a negative second marker in the inset; the antibodies are not labeled, but in context this pattern supports a myeloid/monocytic immunophenotype with loss of B-lineage markers. (D) Interphase FISH with a KMT2A break-apart probe shows one fusion signal and separate red and green signals, confirming KMT2A rearrangement. Findings are consistent with extramedullary relapse of KMT2A-rearranged leukemia with lineage switch from B-lymphoblastic to myeloid (monocytic) phenotype after CD19-directed blinatumomab therapy.

ddx.dx: CD19-negative relapse of B-lymphoblastic leukemia (antigen escape)
ddx.vs: Antigen-escape relapse retains other B-lineage markers such as CD22, CD79a and PAX5 and lacks myeloid markers, which requires IHC or flow rather than morphology.
MPAL co-expresses B and myeloid lineage markers in the same or separate blast populations at diagnosis, whereas lineage switch shows a full conversion at relapse.
Morphology and phenotype overlap; the prior KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL history with the same rearrangement establishes clonal lineage switch.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumors (e.g., Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These are CD45 negative with CD99/NKX2-2 or myogenin/desmin positivity and EWSR1 or FOXO1 rearrangements rather than KMT2A.

61465.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC (unlabeled); FISH: KMT2A break-apart

61401.recognize_zh: A、B 兩張血液抹片中，箭頭指向含有異常大顆粒的少數血小板；C 圖血小板凝集（LTA）顯示 ADP 與 epinephrine 僅有可逆的第一波、collagen 與 arachidonic acid 反應下降，而 ristocetin 正常，符合血小板分泌缺陷（storage pool disease）型態。
features: Panels A/B: platelets of normal size overall, with arrows marking occasional platelets containing coarse, abnormally large purple granules
Red cells normochromic and normocytic; a lymphocyte (A) and a segmented neutrophil with normal granules (B) are present
Panel C: reduced aggregation to collagen 5 and 2 ug/ml and to epinephrine 5 uM
Panel C: ADP 3-5 uM gives a primary wave followed by disaggregation; arachidonic acid 0.5 mg/ml shows a small reversible response
Panel C: ristocetin 1.5 mg/ml produces full aggregation (about 70%) with no response at 0.6 mg/ml, indicating intact GPIb-VWF function
61401.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears (A, B) show normocytic red cells and a normal-appearing neutrophil; a subset of platelets contains unusually large, coarse granules (arrows), while most platelets appear unremarkable. The image resolution does not allow reliable assessment of platelet size distribution. Light transmission aggregometry (C) demonstrates impaired aggregation to collagen, epinephrine and arachidonic acid, with reversible primary-wave-only responses to ADP, whereas high-dose ristocetin-induced agglutination is preserved. This pattern indicates a defect of platelet secretion/amplification rather than a receptor defect such as Glanzmann thrombasthenia or Bernard-Soulier syndrome. Findings are suggestive of a platelet granule disorder (storage pool/secretion defect); confirmation requires whole-mount electron microscopy for dense granules and ATP release studies.

ddx.vs: Absent aggregation to all agonists except ristocetin with no primary wave to ADP, and normal-appearing platelet granules on smear.
Giant platelets with thrombocytopenia and absent ristocetin agglutination, whereas ristocetin response is preserved here.
Absent arachidonic acid response with loss of the secondary wave but no morphologic granule abnormality; history and repeat testing off drug separate them.
Also shows a subset of platelets with giant fused granules, but with thrombocytopenia and 11q23 deletion; electron microscopy identifies alpha versus dense granule abnormality.

61337.recognize_zh: 兩顆相鄰的中小型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質極少，細胞核中央有一道深而長的縱向摺溝，把核分成腦迴狀的兩半並有細褶，染色質緻密、無核仁，這種 cerebriform 核是 Sézary 型細胞的特徵。
features: Two adjacent small-to-medium lymphoid cells, slightly larger than surrounding red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Nuclei bisected by a deep central groove with additional fine folds, producing a cerebriform or coffee-bean appearance
Dense, coarsely clumped chromatin without visible nucleoli
Background normocytic red cells with scattered stain precipitate
61337.describe_en: Smear shows two adjacent small-to-medium lymphoid cells with a very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and scant pale blue cytoplasm. Each nucleus is deeply cleft by a central longitudinal groove with additional fine folds, imparting a cerebriform configuration, and the chromatin is dense without visible nucleoli. The background red cells are unremarkable apart from stain precipitate. In a patient with cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, these cells are consistent with Sézary-type cells, supporting marrow involvement pending immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.dx: Follicular lymphoma / small cleaved B cells
ddx.vs: Buttock cells have a single sharp cleft with angular nuclei and a CD10+ B-cell phenotype, rather than convoluted grooves in CD4+ T cells.
Shows polylobated flower cells with CD25 expression and HTLV-1 positivity.
Have round or slightly indented nuclei without deep grooves.

61273.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織消失，被纖維化間質取代，其中有許多呈放射狀、扇形或玫瑰花狀排列的透亮淡黃結晶，周圍包著多核異物型巨細胞；這種放射狀結晶加上異物巨細胞反應，是草酸鈣沉積（oxalosis）的典型表現。
features: Numerous clear to pale, refractile crystals arranged in radiating, sheaf-like or rosette patterns
Crystals rimmed by multinucleated foreign-body-type giant cells and histiocytes
Marrow spaces replaced by fibrotic stroma with plump spindle cells and small vessels
Hematopoietic elements absent in the field; bony trabecula along the left edge
No significant acute inflammation or necrosis
61273.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows marrow spaces adjacent to a bony trabecula replaced by fibrotic stroma containing numerous radiating, sheaf-like refractile crystal deposits. The crystals are surrounded by multinucleated foreign-body giant cells and histiocytes, and normal hematopoietic tissue is not seen in this field. Polarized light would show strongly birefringent crystals. Findings are consistent with bone marrow oxalosis with a granulomatous foreign-body reaction, in keeping with systemic calcium oxalate deposition from hyperoxaluria and end-stage renal disease.

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are needle-shaped, negatively birefringent and usually dissolved in formalin leaving amorphous pale material, and involve joints/soft tissue rather than diffusely replacing marrow.
Shows cohesive atypical epithelial cells with keratin positivity instead of crystal deposits with giant cells.
Forms epithelioid granulomas often with necrosis and organisms on AFB/GMS stains, without refractile radiating crystals.
Marrow is replaced by sheets of histiocytes with wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm, not crystals with foreign-body giant cells.

61209.recognize_zh: GMS 染色（綠色背景）中，空泡內有一小群大小一致、約 2–4 µm、黑色外壁勾勒的卵圓形酵母體，部分呈窄基出芽，符合組織漿菌。
features: Small cluster of uniform oval yeasts (about 2-4 um) with dark silver-impregnated walls inside a clear vacuole/histiocyte
Some yeasts appear paired, suggesting narrow-based budding
A few additional isolated yeasts in nearby vacuoles
Green (light green) counterstained, vacuolated marrow background; image is overexposed, limiting fine detail
No hyphae identified
61209.describe_en: Grocott methenamine silver stain on the bone marrow biopsy highlights a cluster of small, uniform oval yeast forms with black-staining walls within a clear vacuolated space, with occasional paired forms suggestive of narrow-based budding. Rare isolated yeasts are present nearby, and no hyphae are seen. The image is overexposed, limiting assessment of the background. Findings are consistent with Histoplasma capsulatum.

ddx.vs: Leishmania does not stain with GMS, so silver-positive walls exclude it.
Cryptococcus yeasts are larger and variable in size with a capsule that is mucicarmine or Fontana-Masson positive.
Pneumocystis cysts are GMS-positive but cup- or crescent-shaped, non-budding and usually extracellular in foamy exudate.
C. glabrata is slightly larger and generally requires culture or molecular testing for distinction.

61145.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散布許多圓形或紡錘狀細胞，核圓且居中或偏心，胞質淡而大，內含稀疏、散開的紫色嗜異染顆粒（低顆粒化、顆粒外溢），與右上方密集的顆粒性造血細胞群對照，屬典型非典型肥大細胞。
features: Numerous mast cells with round to oval, central or eccentric nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm
Hypogranular cytoplasm with sparse, unevenly distributed purple metachromatic granules; granules spill into the background
Some cells spindle-shaped or with elongated cytoplasmic tails
Occasional bilobed nuclei ("promastocyte"-like forms)
Dense clusters of granulated myeloid cells at the upper right and scattered erythroid precursors
61145.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen with clustered granulocytic precursors and numerous dispersed mast cells. The mast cells are atypical, with round to bilobed nuclei, abundant pale cytoplasm, and hypogranular, unevenly distributed metachromatic granules that spill into the background; several have spindle-shaped cytoplasmic extensions. The proportion of atypical mast cells is high in this field. Findings are consistent with mast cell leukemia, which requires ≥20% mast cells on aspirate smears and fulfillment of systemic mastocytosis criteria.

ddx.vs: Mast cells account for <20% of nucleated cells on the aspirate smear, whereas mast cell leukemia requires ≥20%.
Reactive mast cells are round, fully and densely granulated with a central nucleus and are few in number.
Basophils are smaller with segmented nuclei and coarse dark granules and arise in a left-shifted granulocytic background with BCR::ABL1.
Abnormal promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei with azurophilic granules and Auer rods and are MPO-strong, tryptase-negative.

61081.recognize_zh: 大型淋巴瘤細胞 CD20 瀰漫膜陽性、CD10 陰性、BCL-6 與 MUM-1 核陽性、BCL-2 強陽性、c-MYC 部分核陽性且 Ki-67 很高，呈非生發中心（activated B-cell）型、MYC/BCL2 共表現的瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤免疫表型，為中樞神經原發 DLBCL 的典型組合。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei in all panels
CD20: strong diffuse membranous positivity
CD10: negative in tumor cells
BCL-6 and MUM-1: nuclear positivity in the majority of tumor cells
BCL-2: strong diffuse cytoplasmic/membranous positivity; c-MYC: nuclear positivity in a substantial subset (estimated ≥40%)
Ki-67: high proliferation index
61081.describe_en: Immunohistochemical panel of a diffuse large lymphoid infiltrate shows the tumor cells to be diffusely positive for CD20 and negative for CD10, with nuclear positivity for BCL-6 and MUM-1. BCL-2 is strongly and diffusely expressed, c-MYC shows nuclear staining in a substantial proportion of cells, and the Ki-67 proliferation index is high. By the Hans algorithm this is a non-germinal center B-cell–like profile with MYC/BCL2 dual expression. In a brain lesion, findings are consistent with primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS; FISH for MYC and BCL2 rearrangement should be considered.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Protein co-expression is not equivalent to rearrangement; FISH demonstrating both MYC and BCL2 translocations is required.

ddx.dx: Systemic DLBCL with secondary CNS involvement
ddx.vs: Immunophenotype overlaps; systemic staging (PET-CT, bone marrow) excludes extracranial disease.
Burkitt lymphoma is CD10+, BCL-6+, BCL-2 negative with near-100% MYC and Ki-67 and shows a MYC translocation.
These show EBER positivity and often plasmablastic/polymorphous features in an immunocompromised host.

61081.stain: IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL-6, MUM-1, BCL-2, c-MYC, Ki-67

61017.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央聚集一群中型、核圓、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質藍染的未成熟細胞，旁有成熟中的骨髓系細胞與小淋巴球；標題為兒童正常造血原細胞（hematogones），但這群細胞的細胞質比典型 hematogone 更多且深藍，形態上也需考慮早期紅血球母細胞，確認須靠流式細胞術。
features: Central cluster of medium-sized immature cells with round nuclei and finely granular, evenly dispersed chromatin
Moderate rims of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, a few with small vacuoles; nucleoli inconspicuous
Occasional small cells with dense, homogeneous dark chromatin and scant cytoplasm (lymphocyte/hematogone-like)
Admixed maturing granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, band neutrophil) and larger cells with grey-blue granular cytoplasm
Cellular aspirate with erythrocyte background and a ruptured granulated cell at lower right
61017.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear from a child shows a cellular particle-adjacent field containing a cluster of medium-sized immature mononuclear cells with round nuclei, fine homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a variable rim of basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with maturing granulocytic precursors and occasional small mature lymphocytes. The cells lack overt nuclear atypia or prominent nucleoli. Although submitted as hematogones, several cells in this cluster have more abundant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm than classic hematogones and overlap morphologically with early erythroid precursors or blasts. Morphology alone cannot reliably separate hematogones from lymphoblasts; flow cytometry demonstrating a normal, continuous B-cell maturation pattern (CD34/CD10/CD20/CD19) is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts form a uniform population with an aberrant, maturation-arrested immunophenotype on flow cytometry, whereas hematogones show a normal continuum of antigen acquisition.
Erythroid precursors have intensely royal-blue cytoplasm, a perinuclear clear zone and often cytoplasmic blebs, and are CD71/E-cadherin-positive rather than CD19/CD10-positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clumps or rosettes with nuclear molding and are CD45-negative, unlike dispersed hematopoietic cells.
Myeloblasts have visible nucleoli, may contain Auer rods, and are MPO-positive.

60953.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片見藍灰色、兩端尖的細長雙錐形結晶，H&E 切片中為嗜伊紅性針狀結晶，電子顯微鏡呈現縱切菱形與橫切六角形的雙錐體結構，符合 Charcot-Leyden 結晶。
features: Aspirate: elongated, blue-gray, bipyramidal (needle/spindle-shaped) crystals with pointed ends
Aspirate background of degenerated/necrotic cells with poorly preserved morphology
Biopsy: cellular marrow with areas of necrosis and eosinophilic crystalline material
High power H&E: bright eosinophilic needle-shaped crystals among crushed small hyperchromatic cells
Electron microscopy: electron-dense crystals with rhomboid longitudinal and hexagonal cross-sectional profiles
60953.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered elongated, blue-gray bipyramidal crystals with tapering ends in a background of degenerated cells. The trephine biopsy is cellular with foci of necrosis, and high-power examination reveals brightly eosinophilic needle-shaped crystals among small hyperchromatic cells. Electron microscopy confirms electron-dense crystals with bipyramidal longitudinal and hexagonal cross-sectional profiles. Findings are consistent with Charcot-Leyden crystals associated with marrow necrosis; the underlying neoplasm (T-lymphoblastic lymphoma in this case) requires immunophenotyping of viable tissue.

ddx.vs: Immunoglobulin crystals lie within histiocyte or plasma cell cytoplasm and are light-chain restricted by IHC, whereas these are extracellular and κ/λ negative.
Urate crystals are dissolved in routine processing, leaving needle-shaped clefts with a foreign-body reaction, and are negatively birefringent.
Cholesterol appears as empty rectangular clefts rather than solid eosinophilic bipyramidal crystals.
Calcium oxalate forms birefringent rosettes or sheaves with granulomatous reaction rather than eosinophilic bipyramids.

60889.recognize_zh: 組合圖中周邊血淋巴球/單核球（C–E）胞質含多個清楚小空泡，骨髓（F、G 箭頭）可見胞質充滿細小泡沫狀空泡的大型泡沫組織球（foam cell），符合 Niemann-Pick 病的儲積細胞。
features: Panels A-B: small lymphocytes with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm (reference cells)
Panels C-E: mononuclear cells with multiple discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles (vacuolated lymphocytes/monocytes)
Panels F-G (arrows): very large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely and coarsely vacuolated 'foamy' (mulberry/soap-bubble) cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
Panel H: large round cell with abundant finely granular/reticulated pink-staining cytoplasm surrounded by small hematopoietic cells, likely a storage histiocyte in a different preparation
No fibrillary 'crinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm as seen in Gaucher cells
60889.describe_en: Composite figure of peripheral blood and bone marrow preparations. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (panels C-E) contain multiple sharply defined clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, compared with non-vacuolated lymphocytes (A-B). The bone marrow aspirate (F-G, arrows) contains large foamy histiocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm packed with uniform small lipid vacuoles and small eccentric nuclei; panel H shows a large storage cell with finely vacuolated/granular cytoplasm, although its stain and specimen type cannot be determined with certainty. Findings are consistent with a lipid storage disorder, in keeping with Niemann-Pick disease type A (acid sphingomyelinase deficiency).

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm that is PAS-positive, rather than the uniform soap-bubble vacuoles of Niemann-Pick foam cells.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green ceroid granules on Wright-Giemsa, whereas classic type A foam cells are pale and vacuolated; enzyme assay/NPC1-NPC2 testing separates them.

ddx.dx: Other lysosomal storage disorders with vacuolated lymphocytes (e.g., Wolman disease, GM1 gangliosidosis, mucopolysaccharidoses)
ddx.vs: Vacuolated lymphocytes are nonspecific; foamy marrow histiocytes plus low acid sphingomyelinase activity (SMPD1 mutation) confirm Niemann-Pick A/B.
Reactive foamy macrophages are sparse and lack the systemic vacuolated lymphocytes and hepatosplenomegaly of a congenital storage disease.

60825.recognize_zh: PD-L1 染色呈大片棕色網狀背景，主要來自組織球與細胞膜；大型腫瘤細胞核空泡狀、胞質相對較淡，周圍有膜狀染色輪廓；大細胞與組織球皆表現 PD-L1，符合 9p24.1 相關的免疫逃脫表型。
features: Diffuse moderate membranous and cytoplasmic PD-L1 staining forming a reticular brown network throughout the field
Large atypical cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei outlined by membranous staining, with relatively paler central cytoplasm
Intense staining in interspersed histiocytes/dendritic-appearing cells with branching cytoplasm
Small background lymphocyte nuclei largely unstained
60825.describe_en: PD-L1 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse moderate membranous and cytoplasmic staining throughout the infiltrate, forming a reticular network. The large atypical cells show membranous outlining with relatively paler cytoplasm, and the surrounding histiocytes stain strongly; it is difficult in this field to separate tumor cell membranes from closely apposed histiocytic processes, so tumor-cell positivity is best confirmed with dual staining. PD-L1 expression by both neoplastic large cells and histiocytes is consistent with the immune-evasion phenotype (9p24.1/PD-L1 alteration) shared by classic Hodgkin lymphoma, primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma and mediastinal gray zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: cHL HRS cells are also PD-L1 positive because of 9p24.1 amplification, so PD-L1 cannot separate them and B-cell markers (CD20, Oct-2) are needed.
PMBL frequently expresses PD-L1 too; distinction relies on monotonous morphology, strong CD20, CD23/MAL and absent CD15.
DLBCL NOS usually shows PD-L1 mainly in tumor-associated macrophages with negative tumor cells, apart from EBV-positive and non-GCB subsets.

60761.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆無核、粉紫色顆粒狀、大小與紅血球相當並帶許多細棘突起的巨大血小板，周圍血小板數量明顯增多，左側三顆嗜中性球核分葉增多（5 葉以上），符合血小板增多症中的巨大血小板。
features: Giant platelet approximately the size of a red cell, anucleate, with fine purple granules and multiple spiky pseudopodial projections
Markedly increased number of platelets scattered throughout the background, including some large forms
Neutrophils with hypersegmented nuclei (five or more lobes)
Red cells normochromic with some overlapping areas and refractile drying artifact; occasional target-like forms
60761.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased number of platelets with anisocytosis, including a giant anucleate platelet about the size of a red cell with granular cytoplasm and spiky pseudopodial projections. Three neutrophils show nuclear hypersegmentation with five or more lobes. Red cells are largely normochromic with drying artifact and no significant schistocytes. Findings are consistent with thrombocytosis with giant platelets and neutrophil hypersegmentation; a myeloproliferative neoplasm and megaloblastic process should be considered and correlated with CBC indices, B12/folate levels and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing.

ddx.vs: Contains a nucleus, often small and dense or with visible chromatin, whereas this giant platelet is entirely anucleate.

ddx.dx: Lymphocyte or nucleated red cell miscounted
ddx.vs: Has a distinct nucleus and uniform cytoplasm without the granular, spiky platelet morphology seen here.
Giant platelets occur with thrombocytopenia, and MYH9 disorders show Döhle-like neutrophil inclusions, unlike this thrombocytosis with hypersegmented neutrophils.
Platelets are usually normal in size without giant forms, and morphology alone cannot exclude it, so iron status, inflammation markers and MPN driver mutations are required.

60633.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片呈大片壞死，細胞輪廓模糊，其中散布金黃至橘褐色、呈放射狀或菱形團塊的結晶沉積物，即血紅質分解產物 hematoidin，常見於骨髓壞死或舊出血處。
features: Panel A (low power): bone trabecula surrounded by extensive necrotic marrow with loss of cellular detail and scattered golden-brown deposits
Panels B and D: golden-yellow to orange-brown pigment forming radiating, needle-like/spiky crystalline aggregates
Panel C: multiple smaller globular and crystalline golden deposits within amorphous eosinophilic necrotic debris
Background of ghost cells, karyorrhectic nuclear debris and pale eosinophilic granular material
No hemosiderin-laden macrophages or viable tumor cells are clearly identified in these fields
60633.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy shows extensive marrow necrosis with ghost-cell outlines, karyorrhectic debris and eosinophilic granular material surrounding bone trabeculae. Scattered throughout are extracellular golden-yellow to orange-brown refractile deposits forming radiating needle-like and rhomboid crystalline aggregates, characteristic of hematoidin (bilirubin-derived pigment formed in hypoxic areas of old hemorrhage). Viable tumor is not identified in these fields, and additional sampling or immunostains may be needed to identify an underlying malignancy. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis with hematoidin crystal deposition.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is coarse granular golden-brown pigment within macrophages that stains with Prussian blue, whereas hematoidin forms extracellular crystals that are Prussian blue negative.
Formalin pigment is fine, dark brown-black, birefringent and evenly scattered over red cells, not large golden radiating crystals.
Melanin is fine brown-black granular pigment within tumor cells that bleaches and stains with Fontana-Masson, unlike extracellular golden crystals in necrosis.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal eosinophilic (not golden) crystals associated with eosinophils.

60697.recognize_zh: 腹部電腦斷層可見肝脾腫大；肝臟切片中肝細胞板之間的竇狀隙內散佈許多深紫黑色的細胞團，染色方式未標示，推測是標示漿細胞的呈色染色（如輕鏈原位雜交），提示腹水來自漿細胞腫瘤的肝臟竇狀隙浸潤，需以標記確認。
features: Panel A (CT, axial): enlarged liver and spleen; no discrete hepatic mass evident; small amount of perihepatic fluid possible but not clearly demonstrated
Panel B: liver core with hepatocyte plates and fine golden-brown cytoplasmic pigment
Panel B: numerous discrete dark purple-black cell clusters within sinusoids and portal areas, distributed diffusely
Stain not labeled; signal intensity and pink background suggest a chromogenic ISH/IHC with red counterstain rather than routine H&E
No mass-forming nodules or amyloid-like eosinophilic deposits identifiable at this magnification
60697.describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced CT shows hepatosplenomegaly without a discrete hepatic mass. The liver biopsy shows preserved hepatocyte plates with fine pigment and numerous dark purple-black cell clusters distributed within the sinusoids and portal areas; the stain is not labeled, but the appearance suggests a chromogenic in situ hybridization or immunostain highlighting an infiltrating cell population. In the context of a plasma cell neoplasm, findings are suggestive of diffuse sinusoidal hepatic infiltration by neoplastic plasma cells as the cause of portal hypertension and ascites; the marker identity and light chain restriction should be confirmed from the original report.

ddx.vs: Amyloid appears as amorphous eosinophilic sinusoidal deposits compressing hepatocyte plates with Congo red apple-green birefringence, not discrete cellular clusters.
LCDD shows linear sinusoidal/basement membrane deposits on kappa/lambda immunofluorescence without cellular infiltrates.

ddx.dx: Hepatic involvement by lymphoma or leukemia
ddx.vs: Lymphoma infiltrates are CD20/CD3 positive and typically portal-based, whereas plasma cell infiltrates are CD138+ with monotypic light chain.

60569.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片中央有一個被空暈包圍的大型細胞，含兩個鏡像排列的空泡狀核與嗜酸性大核仁（貓頭鷹眼 owl-eye），周圍是以小淋巴球為主、夾雜組織球與少數嗜酸性球的背景，符合典型霍奇金淋巴瘤。
features: Central large binucleate cell with mirror-image vesicular nuclei, each containing a prominent eosinophilic nucleolus (owl-eye Reed-Sternberg cell), within a retraction space
Additional scattered large mononuclear Hodgkin-like cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Background rich in small round lymphocytes
Admixed epithelioid histiocytes with pale cytoplasm and oval nuclei
Occasional eosinophils; no sclerotic bands or necrosis in this field
60569.describe_en: Lymph node section shows effacement by a mixed infiltrate predominantly composed of small lymphocytes with admixed histiocytes and scattered eosinophils. Within this background are occasional large atypical cells, including a classic binucleated Reed-Sternberg cell with mirror-image vesicular nuclei and prominent eosinophilic macronucleoli, and mononuclear Hodgkin cells. Findings are consistent with classic Hodgkin lymphoma; subtyping as lymphocyte-rich requires assessment of the nodular architecture and immunophenotype (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5 weak, CD45−).

ddx.vs: NLPHL LP cells lack owl-eye eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD20+/OCT2+/CD45+ with CD30/CD15 negativity, within PD1+ T-cell rosettes.
Mixed cellularity has a more heterogeneous background with abundant eosinophils, plasma cells and histiocytes rather than a predominance of small lymphocytes.
THRLBCL large cells are CD20+/CD45+ and lack CD30/CD15, in a diffuse histiocyte-rich background.

60441.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片骨小樑之間幾乎全是脂肪，只殘存少量散在造血細胞小灶，對 8 歲兒童而言屬明顯低細胞量；下方為血塊組織，對兒童全血球減少應想到兒童頑固性血球減少症與再生不良性貧血的鑑別。
features: Low-power bone marrow core with intact bony trabeculae
Markedly hypocellular intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by adipocytes
Only small patchy foci of residual hematopoietic cells
Separate fragments of clotted blood/aspirate material below the core
Cytologic dysplasia not assessable at this magnification
60441.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows markedly hypocellular intertrabecular spaces composed predominantly of adipocytes with only small patchy foci of residual hematopoiesis, which is well below the expected cellularity for an 8-year-old. Fragments of clotted blood are present separately. Dysplasia cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of pancytopenia and a clonal karyotypic abnormality (der(5)t(1;5)), findings are consistent with hypocellular refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia lacks unequivocal megakaryocytic or granulocytic dysplasia and patchy erythroid islands with left shift, and usually lacks clonal karyotypic abnormalities such as monosomy 7.
Fanconi anemia, dyskeratosis congenita, and GATA2 deficiency require chromosome breakage testing, telomere length, and germline sequencing.
Hypocellular AML shows at least 20% blasts, which can be excluded by CD34 immunostaining and aspirate differential.

60185.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片在低倍下骨小樑間造血組織幾近填滿、脂肪空泡少，細胞密度明顯偏高；巨核細胞散佈且大小不一，部分偏小、核深染，提示骨髓發育不良症候群中的巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow space between bony trabeculae with few residual fat vacuoles
Megakaryocytes scattered throughout, variable in size including small forms with hyperchromatic nuclei
Admixed erythroid and granulocytic elements with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis
Unremarkable bone trabeculae
Detailed nuclear lobation (separated lobes) is not resolvable at this magnification
60185.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with only scattered fat vacuoles between intact bony trabeculae. Trilineage hematopoiesis is present, and megakaryocytes are readily identified and vary in size, including small forms with hyperchromatic nuclei. At this magnification the finer megakaryocytic dysplastic features, such as separated nuclear lobes, cannot be fully assessed. In the context of dysplasia and increased blasts on the aspirate, findings support myelodysplastic syndrome with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are large, clustered and hyperlobated or bulbous, rather than small hypolobated forms, with associated peripheral cytosis instead of cytopenias.
AML shows sheets of blasts replacing the marrow, which requires CD34 immunostaining or aspirate counts (≥20%) to exclude.
Reactive marrow has normal megakaryocyte morphology and no increase in CD34-positive blasts.

60057.recognize_zh: 左上 H&E 高倍可見一片中型母細胞，核卵圓或不規則、染色質細緻、可見有絲分裂像；其餘三格免疫染色顯示這群細胞瀰漫 CD34 陽性（膜）、CD79a 陽性（B 系）與 TdT 核陽性（前驅細胞），合併起來確認為 B 淋巴母細胞白血病。
features: H&E: sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with oval to irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant pale cytoplasm
H&E: scattered mitotic figures, interspersed small dark residual cells, and a hemosiderin-laden macrophage
IHC CD34: diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic positivity in the blast population
IHC CD79a: diffuse cytoplasmic positivity supporting B lineage
IHC TdT: strong nuclear positivity in nearly all blasts, confirming precursor stage
60057.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow core biopsy shows sheets of intermediate-sized blasts with oval to irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm, with scattered mitotic figures and a hemosiderin-laden macrophage among few residual hematopoietic cells. Immunohistochemistry shows that the blasts are diffusely positive for CD34, CD79a, and nuclear TdT. The immature precursor phenotype with B-lineage marker expression is consistent with extensive marrow involvement by B-lymphoblastic leukemia; with the reported aberrant CD13 on flow cytometry and t(9;22), findings support B-lymphoblastic leukemia with BCR::ABL1 fusion.

ddx.vs: Blasts may be CD34+ and occasionally TdT+, but lack diffuse CD79a/PAX5 and are typically MPO or CD117 positive.
Also TdT+ and often CD34+, but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks CD79a/PAX5/CD19.
Shows high mitotic activity but blasts are TdT and CD34 negative, CD20 and CD10 positive with a Ki-67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement.
Can mimic lymphoblasts on H&E but is TdT and CD34 negative and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

30169.recognize_zh: H&E 切片中骨骼肌纖維之間被密集、核不規則且深染的異型淋巴球浸潤並破壞（A），免疫染色腫瘤細胞呈強膜/細胞質陽性（B）與核陽性（D），PCR 電泳證實 HTLV-1 pX 區段陽性（C），綜合符合成人 T 細胞白血病/淋巴瘤（ATLL）侵犯肌肉。
features: Panel A: dense infiltrate of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei dissecting between and replacing skeletal muscle fibers
Panel B: diffuse strong membranous/cytoplasmic immunostaining of the infiltrating lymphoid cells (antigen not labeled)
Panel C: PCR agarose gel showing a 327 bp HTLV-1 pX band in the patient sample, with internal control and positive/negative controls
Panel D: nuclear immunostaining in a large proportion of tumor cells (antigen not labeled)
30169.describe_en: Composite figure. Skeletal muscle (A, H&E) is extensively infiltrated by atypical medium to large lymphoid cells with irregular hyperchromatic nuclei that dissect between and destroy muscle fibers. The tumor cells show diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic immunostaining (B) and nuclear immunostaining (D); the specific antigens are not labeled in the figure. PCR (C) demonstrates the 327 bp HTLV-1 pX product in the patient sample alongside the positive control, with an internal control band and a clean negative control. Findings are consistent with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma with destructive muscular infiltration; the expected immunophenotype is CD3+, CD4+, CD25+ and often FOXP3/CCR4 positive.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS can look identical but is HTLV-1 negative, so clonal HTLV-1 integration is the key discriminator.
DLBCL cells express CD20/PAX5 and lack T-cell markers and HTLV-1 provirus.
Polymyositis shows endomysial small mature lymphocytes invading non-necrotic fibers without cytologic atypia or a monotonous destructive sheet.

ddx.dx: Rhabdomyosarcoma or other small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: These tumors express desmin/myogenin or other lineage markers and are CD45 negative.

23065.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中一顆骨髓細胞（myelocyte）的細胞質內有一小團深藍紫色、桑椹狀的包涵體（morula），緊貼核旁，符合嗜粒細胞型無形體（Anaplasma）感染。
features: Single myelocyte with a round-oval nucleus and moderately granular grey-blue cytoplasm
Small, dense basophilic stippled intracytoplasmic inclusion (morula) adjacent to the nucleus
A mature segmented neutrophil elsewhere in the field without inclusions
Numerous echinocytes (crenated red cells), likely at least partly artifactual
Scattered platelets; no intraerythrocytic parasites
23065.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (400x) shows numerous crenated erythrocytes and scattered platelets. A circulating myelocyte contains a small, dark basophilic, granular intracytoplasmic inclusion abutting the nucleus, with the stippled mulberry-like appearance of a morula. A nearby segmented neutrophil lacks inclusions and no intraerythrocytic parasites are seen. Findings are consistent with human granulocytic anaplasmosis (Anaplasma phagocytophilum); confirmation by PCR or serology is recommended since morulae are seen in only a minority of granulocytes.

ddx.vs: E. chaffeensis morulae are found predominantly in monocytes, whereas Anaplasma morulae are in neutrophils and granulocytic precursors.
Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, homogeneous peripheral cytoplasmic patches, not dark stippled clusters.
A superimposed platelet or precipitate lies in a different focal plane and is not enclosed within the cytoplasm.
Histoplasma appears as multiple discrete 2-4 um oval yeasts with a clear halo rather than a single granular aggregate.

17753.recognize_zh: 低倍視野中散布多個大小不一、由數十顆血小板聚成的紫色團塊，位於紅血球之間與抹片邊緣，單獨散在的血小板相對少，符合血小板凝集（platelet clumping），是自動計數假性血小板低下的常見原因。
features: Multiple variably sized aggregates of platelets scattered among RBCs, including large clumps at the upper left and upper right
Clumps composed of individual granular platelets without a surrounding fibrin strand or nucleus
Few isolated single platelets in the background
Several unremarkable segmented neutrophils; some platelets adjacent to neutrophils
RBCs appear normocytic without significant poikilocytosis; field is from a thin smear area
17753.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low-to-medium power shows numerous platelet aggregates of variable size distributed throughout the field, with relatively few isolated platelets in between. Scattered segmented neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable, and red cells show no significant poikilocytosis. Platelet clumps cause automated analyzers to undercount platelets. Findings are consistent with platelet clumping, most often an in vitro EDTA-dependent artifact producing pseudothrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrate or heparin, or examination of a fingerstick smear, is recommended.

ddx.vs: In true thrombocytopenia platelets are sparse throughout the smear and no aggregates are seen, including at the feathered edge.
Satellitism shows platelets rosetting around neutrophils rather than free-standing clumps, although both are EDTA-related artifacts.
A partially clotted sample shows platelet clumps enmeshed in fibrin strands with falsely low counts of multiple lineages; redrawing is needed.
Giant platelets are single platelets approaching RBC size that are also excluded by analyzers, not aggregates of normal-sized platelets.

12697.recognize_zh: 長期腸衰竭（需中心靜脈營養）患者的周邊血抹片中，一顆白血球細胞質內聚集數個圓形、深藍色的酵母菌樣小體，大小一致且比血小板大，提示念珠菌血症（candidemia），需以血液培養確認。
features: A leukocyte containing a cluster of 3-4 round to oval, deeply basophilic yeast-like bodies
Inclusions are uniform, about 3-5 µm, larger than platelets, with a faint surrounding clear zone
Host cell nucleus is compressed and irregular around the organisms
No pseudohyphae or extracellular organisms visible in this field
Background red cells normochromic with scattered small dark punctate artifacts; few platelets
12697.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single leukocyte containing a cluster of several round to oval, deeply basophilic, yeast-like intracytoplasmic inclusions of uniform size, larger than platelets and displacing the host nucleus. No pseudohyphae or extracellular organisms are seen in this field, and the red cells and platelets are otherwise unremarkable apart from small punctate artifacts. In a patient with a long-term central venous catheter for parenteral nutrition, findings are suggestive of fungemia, most likely Candida; confirmation by blood culture is required.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are smaller (2-4 µm), more numerous within monocytes/neutrophils, and show an eccentric chromatin crescent with a clear pseudocapsule.
Ingested platelets are granular and irregular and nuclear debris is dense and pyknotic, unlike uniform oval yeasts with smooth outlines.
Malassezia shows small oval yeasts with broad-based collarette budding and requires lipid-supplemented culture media.
Döhle bodies are pale gray-blue peripheral cytoplasmic patches and toxic vacuoles are clear, whereas these inclusions are discrete dense basophilic bodies.

14297.recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液抹片中多數細胞為核偏位、胞質深藍、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）的漿細胞，染色質呈車輪狀粗塊，另夾雜少數淋巴球與單核球樣細胞，屬於腦脊髓液漿細胞增多。
features: Numerous plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm
Coarsely clumped, clock-face chromatin
Distinct perinuclear clear zone (hof) in several cells
Mixed background of small lymphocytes and monocytoid cells; no neutrophil predominance in this field
Plasma cells appear mature without prominent nucleoli, binucleation or marked pleomorphism
14297.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a mononuclear pleocytosis with numerous mature-appearing plasma cells, characterized by eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof. Small lymphocytes and monocytoid cells are also present. No atypical plasmablasts, organisms or tumor cells are identified. Findings are consistent with CSF plasmacytosis, most often reactive to infection such as neurosyphilis, viral or bacterial meningitis; clinical correlation and, if persistent, flow cytometric light-chain assessment to exclude CNS myeloma are recommended.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by plasma cell myeloma
ddx.vs: Myelomatous plasma cells are often immature with nucleoli and pleomorphism and show light-chain restriction by flow cytometry or immunocytochemistry.
Bing-Neel shows a mixture of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with MYD88 L265P and a clonal IgM paraprotein.
Reactive lymphocytes have more central nuclei and lack the prominent hof and clock-face chromatin of plasma cells.

12889.recognize_zh: 四格周邊血中可見核濃縮成深紫色團塊、染色質碎裂、細胞質皺縮的凋亡淋巴球（apoptotic lymphocytes），以及一顆細胞質深藍、有空泡的反應性淋巴球；年輕人發燒咽喉痛時看到這些細胞，應聯想傳染性單核球增多症。
features: Apoptotic lymphocytes with shrunken cells and condensed, pyknotic or fragmented dark nuclear chromatin
Apoptotic cells show irregular, retracted cytoplasm with blebbing
One reactive lymphocyte with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm (top left)
Small dense round nucleus in a compact cell (top right) consistent with early apoptosis
Background red cells normocytic; occasional platelets
12889.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several apoptotic lymphocytes characterized by cell shrinkage, condensed pyknotic nuclei with chromatin fragmentation, and irregular retracted cytoplasm. A reactive lymphocyte with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm is also present. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Increased circulating apoptotic lymphocytes accompanying reactive lymphocytes are a recognized clue to acute viral infection and, in a young adult with fever and pharyngitis, are suggestive of infectious mononucleosis; heterophile antibody and EBV serology are recommended.

ddx.vs: Orthochromatic normoblasts have a single round dense nucleus in pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm, not grey-blue lymphoid cytoplasm with nuclear fragments.

ddx.dx: Smudge cells of chronic lymphocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: Smudge cells are crushed nuclei without cytoplasm, whereas apoptotic cells retain a cytoplasmic rim around condensed nuclear fragments.
Aged EDTA samples show diffuse degenerative changes in many leukocyte types, including neutrophils, rather than selective apoptotic lymphocytes with reactive forms.
Neoplastic cells have intact nuclei with fine or open chromatin and nucleoli, not pyknosis and karyorrhexis.

11865.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中四顆淋巴球，其中一顆核有明顯凹陷、呈淺分葉，其餘染色質濃縮、核輪廓略不規則，胞質很少；屬於 ATLL 中較不典型、需配合 HTLV-1 與流式檢查的型態。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
One cell with a deeply indented, partially lobulated nucleus
Condensed, coarsely granular chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells with mild crenation; occasional platelets
11865.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a group of small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with scant agranular cytoplasm and condensed chromatin. Nuclear outlines are mildly irregular, and one cell displays a deep indentation with early lobulation; classic polylobated flower cells are not seen in this field. Red cells show mild crenation and platelets are present. The findings are compatible with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in the appropriate clinical setting but are not specific by themselves.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have finely grooved cerebriform nuclei and a CD26-negative phenotype without HTLV-1, in contrast to CD25-bright HTLV-1-positive ATLL.
Mantle cell lymphoma cells may have notched nuclei but are CD5+ B cells with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size with more abundant cytoplasm and no aberrant loss of pan-T-cell antigens.

7577.recognize_zh: 一顆巨噬細胞的細胞質塞滿數十至上百個細小橢圓形蟲體，每個蟲體有一個紫紅色核，部分可見旁邊的小棒狀動基體（kinetoplast），即利什曼原蟲的 Leishman-Donovan body。
features: Large macrophage distended by innumerable small (2 to 4 um) oval intracytoplasmic organisms
Each amastigote has a round purple nucleus and, in some, a small rod-like kinetoplast
Organisms lack a surrounding clear capsule or halo
Macrophage nucleus compressed and partly obscured by the parasite load
Background of red cells and an adjacent histiocyte nucleus in a marrow aspirate
7577.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large histiocyte whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous small oval organisms. Each organism contains a nucleus, and a separate small bar-shaped kinetoplast is visible in several, characteristic of amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies). No capsule or halo surrounds the organisms. Findings are consistent with visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a pseudocapsular clear halo and no kinetoplast, and they are GMS/PAS positive whereas Leishmania is not.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescentic without a kinetoplast and form cysts rather than filling macrophages this densely.
They are morphologically similar with a kinetoplast but occur mainly in cardiac and smooth muscle rather than marrow macrophages, so geography and serology/PCR separate them.

3097.recognize_zh: 兩顆大型組織球的細胞質被大小一致的小透明空泡填滿，呈泡沫狀（foamy），細胞核相對小而偏位，周圍是一般骨髓造血細胞，這就是泡沫狀組織球。
features: Large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm filled with numerous small, uniform clear vacuoles (foamy appearance)
Small, relatively inconspicuous nuclei displaced by vacuoles
Occasional larger clear lipid droplets within and adjacent to the histiocytes
No striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm and no sea-blue granules
Background of normal-appearing erythroid and myeloid precursors
3097.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular particles with trilineage hematopoietic elements. Scattered large histiocytes contain abundant cytoplasm distended by innumerable small, uniform clear vacuoles, imparting a foamy appearance. The cytoplasm lacks the fibrillar striations of Gaucher cells and the blue-green granules of sea-blue histiocytes. Findings are consistent with foamy (lipid-laden) histiocytes, a nonspecific finding that warrants clinical correlation for storage disorders, hyperlipidemia or recent therapy.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillar 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete round clear vacuoles.
Niemann-Pick cells are also foamy but often show blue-green ceroid granules on Wright-Giemsa; enzyme assay (acid sphingomyelinase) confirms.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with atypical, often hyperchromatic nuclei, whereas these histiocytes are single with bland small nuclei.
Fat cells contain one large clear vacuole with a compressed peripheral nucleus, not many small uniform vacuoles.

1369.recognize_zh: 血片中幾乎找不到正常小型血小板，中央只有一顆比紅血球還大的巨大血小板（深紫色顆粒中心、周圍淡藍色透明區），紅血球形態大致正常，符合免疫性血小板低下（ITP）周邊破壞增加的表現。
features: Single giant platelet larger than adjacent red cells, with a dense purple granulomere and pale blue hyalomere
Marked scarcity of normal-sized platelets in the field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic; a few irregular forms likely drying artifact
No schistocytes, spherocytes, or platelet clumps identified
No leukocytes in this field for assessment of inclusions
1369.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows markedly decreased platelets, with a single giant platelet exceeding the diameter of a red cell in the center of the field. Red cells are predominantly normocytic and normochromic without definite schistocytes or spherocytes, and no platelet clumps are present. Image resolution limits assessment of fine red cell detail. In the context of isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with increased peripheral platelet destruction such as immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: A lymphocyte has a round nucleus with condensed chromatin and a rim of blue cytoplasm, whereas this structure has a granular purple center without nuclear chromatin pattern.
Inherited giant platelet disorders cannot be excluded by a single field and require family history, neutrophil inclusion search, and platelet glycoprotein studies.
TTP shows schistocytes and polychromasia with anemia, which are not evident here.

2713.recognize_zh: 高倍下有一顆大型細胞，細胞質豐富、被染成洋紅色（magenta），內部呈皺摺條紋狀，核偏向一側，符合 PAS 陽性的高雪氏細胞（Gaucher cell）；影像失焦，細節有限。
features: Single large cell with abundant cytoplasm and an eccentric, somewhat compressed nucleus
Cytoplasm stains intensely magenta with a crinkled, striated (wrinkled tissue paper) texture
Surrounding smaller cells with purple nuclei lack the magenta cytoplasmic staining
Image is out of focus, limiting nuclear and fibrillary detail
2713.describe_en: High-power view of a bone marrow section shows a large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm and an eccentric nucleus. The cytoplasm is strongly magenta-positive and displays a crumpled, fibrillary texture, whereas surrounding hematopoietic cells do not show this staining. The stain appears to be PAS, though this is not labeled, and the image is out of focus, limiting assessment. Findings are consistent with a PAS-positive Gaucher cell.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells (CML, myeloma, thalassemia, mycobacterial infection)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look nearly identical and require clinical context, glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA testing, and review for the underlying neoplasm or infection.
MAC histiocytes have striated cytoplasm too but are packed with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, vacuolated foamy cytoplasm with only weak PAS staining, rather than fibrillary strongly PAS-positive cytoplasm.

1177.recognize_zh: 高倍下多數是大型母細胞，核圓或稍不規則、染色質細緻、可見明顯核仁，胞質少到中等且多半沒有顆粒，只有少數細胞含粗顆粒；幾乎看不到分葉或桿狀核顆粒球，符合無成熟的 AML。
features: Predominance of large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, mostly agranular
Few cells with coarse azurophilic granules; maturing myelocytes, bands and neutrophils essentially absent
No Auer rods clearly identified in this field
1177.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a predominance of large blasts with round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli and scant to moderate agranular basophilic cytoplasm. A small minority of cells contain coarse azurophilic granules, but maturing granulocytes beyond the promyelocyte stage are essentially absent. No Auer rods are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia without maturation, with myeloid lineage to be confirmed by MPO cytochemistry or flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Agranular blasts overlap morphologically, so MPO positivity in >=3% of blasts or myeloid immunophenotype is needed to exclude ALL.
Would show >=10% maturing granulocytes, which are not present in this field.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, delicate lacy chromatin and nonspecific esterase positivity, rather than scant basophilic cytoplasm.

1241.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下幾乎全被中型未成熟細胞取代，核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻、可見小核仁，部分細胞胞質呈淡粉紅（顆粒球分化），正常脂肪與三系造血消失；切片可看出白血病取代骨髓，但成熟比例仍須靠抽吸液計數。
features: Diffuse sheets of intermediate-sized immature cells replacing marrow space
Round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm in a subset of cells, suggesting granulocytic differentiation
Scattered cells with smaller, more condensed nuclei; megakaryocytes and erythroid islands not evident
Scattered extravasated red cells; fat spaces markedly reduced
1241.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows diffuse replacement of the marrow by sheets of intermediate-sized immature cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate amounts of pale cytoplasm. A subset of cells has more eosinophilic cytoplasm and smaller, more condensed nuclei, suggesting some granulocytic maturation, whereas normal erythroid islands and megakaryocytes are not evident. The histologic features support involvement by acute myeloid leukemia; enumeration of maturing granulocytes on the aspirate or CD34/MPO immunostains is needed to classify it as AML with maturation.

ddx.vs: Histology cannot reliably quantify maturing granulocytes, so the aspirate differential (<10% maturing cells) distinguishes it.
Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and no eosinophilic granulocytic differentiation, and are TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive and MPO negative.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with keratin positivity, whereas this discohesive sheet of immature cells requires MPO/CD34/CD117 staining.

1305.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，淋巴聚集內的陽性棕色細胞環繞一個淡色、陰性的圓形中心區，形成環狀（ring）分布，此模式代表陽性的是濾泡周邊（外套區）細胞，而中央生發中心為陰性，符合反應性生發中心。
features: Lymphoid aggregate with brown-staining cells forming a ring around a pale, largely negative central nodule
Negative center contains larger pale cells and a vessel, consistent with a germinal center
Positive cells extend in a broad band away from the center into the rest of the aggregate
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow and fat are negative
Bony trabeculae at left and right edges
1305.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows a lymphoid aggregate in which positive cells form a ring around a pale, negative central nodule. This zonal pattern indicates a germinal center that is negative for the marker, surrounded by positive mantle/perifollicular lymphocytes; the specific antibody is not stated, but BCL2, IgD or a T-cell marker would produce this pattern. The preserved follicular architecture favors a reactive process. Findings are consistent with a bone marrow lymphoid follicle with a germinal center.

ddx.vs: If the stain is BCL2, neoplastic follicle centers would be positive rather than negative as in this image.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma colonizing a follicle
ddx.vs: Colonization shows marker-positive neoplastic cells infiltrating into the germinal center, disrupting the clean negative center seen here.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma with mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands the mantle zone with cyclin D1/SOX11-positive cells; cyclin D1 staining would separate it from a reactive mantle.

1049.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中兩顆大型淋巴球，細胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣呈扇貝狀並被周圍紅血球擠壓，接觸處邊緣變深藍，這是傳染性單核球增多症的反應性淋巴球（reactive lymphocytes, Downey cells）。
features: Large lymphocytes, roughly 2-3 times the diameter of a red cell
Moderate to low N:C ratio with abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm
Cytoplasmic margins scalloped around adjacent red cells with peripheral basophilia
Oval to round nuclei with moderately condensed, open chromatin; no distinct nucleoli
Background red cells normochromic without notable poikilocytosis; rare platelets
1049.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large reactive lymphocytes with abundant pale blue cytoplasm that indents around neighboring red cells, with deeper basophilia at the cell margins. Nuclei are oval with moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli; there are no blast features or cytoplasmic granules. Red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with reactive (atypical) lymphocytosis, as seen in infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts have high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas these cells have abundant scalloped cytoplasm and mature-appearing chromatin.
LGL cells show distinct azurophilic cytoplasmic granules and a persistent clonal population, while these cells lack granules and form a heterogeneous reactive spectrum.
Monocytes have folded or lobulated nuclei, grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and lack the red-cell-hugging peripheral basophilia.

4185.recognize_zh: 抽吸抹片中成群的圓形至卵圓形細胞，細胞質充滿深紫色顆粒、細胞核位於中央且顏色較淡，符合肥大細胞（mast cells）聚集；部分細胞顆粒較少，為系統性肥大細胞增生症常見的非典型肥大細胞。
features: Cohesive clusters and sheets of medium to large round/oval cells
Cytoplasm packed with dense dark purple metachromatic granules
Central round to oval nuclei appearing paler than the granular cytoplasm
Some cells hypogranular with pale blue cytoplasm and fewer granules
Occasional spindled or irregular cell outlines at cluster edges
4185.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear contains aggregates of numerous mast cells with abundant cytoplasm filled with dark purple metachromatic granules and central round to oval nuclei. A subset shows partial hypogranularity and irregular or elongated contours. Such mast cell aggregates are not seen in reactive marrows. Findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis; correlation with the biopsy (tryptase/CD117 aggregates, CD25/CD2 aberrancy), serum tryptase and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Basophils have segmented or lobated nuclei with granules overlying the nucleus and are smaller, whereas mast cells have round central nuclei and do not form tight aggregates in blood.
Reactive mast cells are scattered singly, well granulated and round, without aggregates, spindling or CD25/CD2 expression.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and agranular basophilic cytoplasm.

4057.recognize_zh: 細胞密度高的骨髓切片中，只見棕色陽性細胞零星散布於間質，沒有形成緊密聚集；此圖標記未標示，單憑這種散在分布無法滿足系統性肥大細胞增生症的主要標準，需搭配 CD25 與其他切片判讀。
features: Hypercellular marrow with scattered immunoreactive cells
Positive cells distributed singly and in small loose groups in the interstitium
No compact aggregates of positive cells in this field
Positive cells small, round to slightly spindled
Majority of hematopoietic cells negative
4057.describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows scattered positive cells distributed singly and in small loose clusters throughout the interstitium. No compact multifocal aggregates are identified in this field. If this represents a mast cell marker, an interstitial increase of mast cells alone does not meet the WHO major criterion, and minor criteria (spindled morphology >25%, CD25/CD2/CD30 aberrancy, KIT D816V, serum tryptase >20 ng/mL) must be evaluated. Findings are suggestive of, but not by themselves diagnostic of, marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, CD25-negative and lack KIT D816V despite an interstitial increase.

ddx.dx: Normal scattered CD117+ progenitors or plasma cells
ddx.vs: CD117 also stains myeloid progenitors, and tryptase or CD25 co-expression is needed to confirm mast cell identity.
Scattered interstitial CD3+ T cells are small round lymphocytes without granular cytoplasm and are tryptase-negative.

3993.recognize_zh: 周邊血中許多紅血球的中央淡染區呈細長裂縫狀（箭頭），像嘴巴一樣，這就是口形紅血球（stomatocyte）；視野中另有兩顆嗜中性球與一顆偏大的多染性紅血球。
features: Numerous red cells with slit-like, mouth-shaped central pallor (stomatocytes, arrow)
Stomatocytes distributed across the field rather than only in thick areas
Occasional larger polychromatophilic red cell (upper right)
Two neutrophils, one with a band-like nucleus; a partial lymphocyte at lower left
No spherocytes, target cells or red cell fragments prominent
3993.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with slit-like central pallor (stomatocytes, arrow) distributed evenly across a well-spread area of the smear. An occasional larger polychromatophilic red cell is noted. Leukocytes, including two neutrophils, appear unremarkable. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis; if artifact is excluded, differential considerations include hereditary stomatocytosis, liver disease with alcohol use, and Rh-null phenotype.

ddx.vs: Artifactual stomatocytes appear only in thick areas of the smear and disappear in well-spread areas or wet preparations, whereas true stomatocytes are present throughout.
Spherocytes are small dense cells lacking central pallor, while stomatocytes retain a slit-like pallor; osmotic fragility and EMA binding help separate them.
SAO shows oval cells with one or two transverse bars or slits (theta cells), and is caused by a SLC4A1 deletion.
Morphology is similar; clinical history and absence of family history distinguish acquired from hereditary forms.

3929.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中巨核細胞成群聚集，細胞核深染、呈雲朵狀或球狀（cloud-like, bulbous nuclei），伴隨擴張的竇狀血管與竇內造血，是原發性骨髓纖維化的典型巨核細胞異型性。
features: Tight clusters of atypical megakaryocytes
Hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei with abnormal lobation and some naked nuclei
Increased megakaryocyte N:C ratio and size variation
Dilated sinusoids containing hematopoietic cells (intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis)
Fibrotic, streaming stroma between cell clusters
Scattered erythroid and granulocytic precursors with focal pigment
3929.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows marked megakaryocytic hyperplasia with tight clusters of atypical megakaryocytes displaying hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei, abnormal lobation and occasional naked nuclei. The stroma appears fibrotic, and dilated sinusoids contain intraluminal hematopoietic elements. Bony trabeculae are not included in this field. Findings are consistent with a fibrotic-phase myeloproliferative neoplasm, most suggestive of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin/trichrome staining and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, loosely dispersed rather than tightly clustered, and lack significant fibrosis.
MDS megakaryocytes are small with hypolobated or separated nuclei (micromegakaryocytes), accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive epithelial nests with keratin positivity, whereas these large cells are megakaryocytes that express CD61/CD42b.
Morphology is similar; distinction requires documented prior polycythemia vera history.

3609.recognize_zh: 細胞核分成三葉、中間以細絲相連，染色質粗塊狀，細胞質淡粉紅、布滿均勻的細小顆粒，沒有中毒性顆粒或空泡；這是正常的分葉中性球。
features: Mature neutrophil about 1.5-2 times RBC diameter
Nucleus with three lobes connected by thin chromatin filaments
Coarsely clumped chromatin; no nucleoli
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine, evenly distributed lilac granules
No toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, or vacuoles
Background RBCs overlapping in a thick area; scattered normal platelets
3609.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with three nuclear lobes connected by thin filaments and coarsely clumped chromatin. The cytoplasm is pale pink with fine, evenly distributed neutrophilic granules, without toxic granulation, Döhle bodies, or vacuoles. Surrounding red cells are overlapping and platelets are normal. Findings represent normal segmented neutrophil morphology.

ddx.vs: Band neutrophils have a curved nucleus of uniform width without filamentous constrictions between lobes.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have 6 or more lobes, whereas this cell has three.
Pelger-Huët cells are bilobed (pince-nez) or non-segmented with very coarse chromatin, often hypogranular.

3481.recognize_zh: 低倍下大腸黏膜（上方隱窩）之下，黏膜下層被大量大小相近、背靠背緊密排列（back-to-back）的淋巴結節占滿，結節間只有細纖維間隔、缺少明顯套區與極性，這種結節性浸潤型態提示濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Colonic mucosa with preserved crypts overlying a dense submucosal lymphoid infiltrate
Numerous closely packed, back-to-back nodules of relatively uniform size
Nodules lack well-defined mantle zones and zonal polarization
Thin fibrous bands separating nodules
No lymphoepithelial destruction of the overlying crypts evident at this power
3481.describe_en: Low-power section of the colonic polyp shows intact colonic mucosa overlying a dense lymphoid proliferation that expands the submucosa. The infiltrate is composed of numerous closely packed nodules of fairly uniform size separated by thin fibrous septa, with attenuated or absent mantle zones and no obvious germinal center polarity. The mucosal crypts are preserved. The nodular architecture is suggestive of follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed by cytology and immunostains (CD10, BCL6, BCL2).

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are fewer, variably sized and widely spaced with polarized germinal centers, tingible-body macrophages, intact mantles and BCL2-negative germinal centers.
MCL shows vaguely nodular or mantle-zone growth of monotonous cells without centroblasts and is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows marginal-zone/monocytoid cells expanding between follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and is CD10 and BCL6 negative.

3353.recognize_zh: 間期細胞核 FISH 影像：一個黃色融合訊號代表正常等位基因，另有分開的紅色與綠色訊號，表示 ALK 分離探針（break-apart）斷裂重排，支持 ALK 陽性間變性大細胞淋巴瘤。
