features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained blue with DAPI
One fused yellow (red-green overlapping) signal representing an intact allele
One separate green signal and one separate red signal widely apart, indicating a split
Signal pattern 1F1R1G is consistent with rearrangement of the probed locus
Single cell shown; percentage of abnormal nuclei cannot be assessed from this image
3353.describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization with a dual-color break-apart probe shows a DAPI-counterstained nucleus with one fused yellow signal and one separated red and green signal pair (1F1R1G). The separated signals indicate a break within the probed locus on one allele, while the fused signal represents the normal allele. In the context of anaplastic large cell lymphoma, this pattern is consistent with ALK (2p23) rearrangement, most commonly t(2;5)(p23;q35) NPM1::ALK; only a single nucleus is shown, so the proportion of abnormal cells must be taken from the full scoring report.

ddx.vs: A normal nucleus shows two fused yellow signals (2F), without separated red and green signals.
Apparent splits due to nuclear three-dimensionality are small (less than two signal diameters), whereas true rearrangements show widely separated signals as here.

ddx.dx: DUSP22 or TP63 rearrangement in ALK-negative ALCL
ddx.vs: These are detected with their own locus-specific break-apart probes and occur with ALK immunostain negativity.

3225.recognize_zh: 脂肪空泡旁一顆組織球的細胞質內含多顆完整紅血球，並夾雜數個小而深染的圓形有核細胞（紅血球前驅細胞或淋巴球），同時吞噬紅血球與有核細胞，符合噬血現象。
features: Histiocyte containing multiple intact orange-red erythrocytes
Several engulfed small nucleated cells with dense, round nuclei among the ingested red cells
Histiocyte located adjacent to a large fat vacuole
Surrounding cellular marrow with erythroid precursors and larger cells with open chromatin
No granulomas or sheets of atypical cells in this field
3225.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a histiocyte containing numerous intact erythrocytes together with several small nucleated cells with dense round nuclei, likely erythroid precursors or lymphocytes. The histiocyte lies adjacent to a fat vacuole within cellular marrow containing erythroid precursors and larger mononuclear cells. No granulomas or overt lymphomatous infiltrate is identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis, including phagocytosis of nucleated cells, in the setting of acute EBV infection; formal HLH criteria should be applied.

ddx.vs: Erythroblastic islands show nucleated erythroid cells arranged around a macrophage rather than enclosed within its cytoplasm alongside ingested red cells.
Emperipolesis in Rosai-Dorfman involves intact lymphocytes within large S100+ histiocytes, typically in lymph node sinuses, without erythrophagocytosis.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and contain passing hematopoietic cells, not phagocytosed erythrocytes.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows sheets of cytologically atypical, pleomorphic histiocytes rather than scattered bland phagocytic histiocytes.

3033.recognize_zh: 兩個明顯大於正常的顆粒球前驅細胞，上方細胞的核呈馬蹄形或 C 形、染色質比應有的成熟度更細緻疏鬆，核質發育不同步，細胞直徑約為紅血球的三倍以上，這是巨大後骨髓球（giant metamyelocyte），常見於巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Markedly enlarged granulocytic precursors, roughly 3 times the diameter of adjacent RBCs
Upper cell with horseshoe/C-shaped indented nucleus typical of a metamyelocyte-to-band stage
Chromatin finer and more open than expected for this stage (nuclear-cytoplasmic dyssynchrony)
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine granules and a basophilic rim
Second large cell below with an oval nucleus and similar open chromatin
3033.describe_en: Smear shows two large granulocytic precursors. The upper cell measures roughly three red cell diameters and has a horseshoe-shaped nucleus with finely stippled, relatively open chromatin, surrounded by abundant finely granular cytoplasm; the lower cell is similarly large with an oval nucleus. The mismatch between nuclear shape (late stage) and immature chromatin reflects nuclear-cytoplasmic dyssynchrony. Findings are consistent with giant metamyelocytes/bands, a characteristic feature of megaloblastic hematopoiesis such as vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: Normal metamyelocytes are about 10-15 micrometers with condensed chromatin, whereas giant forms are much larger with inappropriately open chromatin.
Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and folded lacy nuclei, not the neutrophilic granular cytoplasm and kidney-shaped nucleus of a metamyelocyte.

ddx.dx: Dysplastic myeloid precursor in MDS or drug effect
ddx.vs: Morphology can overlap; normal B12/folate levels, hypogranularity, pseudo-Pelger forms, and cytogenetics favor MDS or drug-related (e.g., methotrexate, hydroxyurea) megaloblastoid change.

2969.recognize_zh: 低倍鐵染色（Prussian blue）的骨髓顆粒中可見大量分支狀藍色含鐵血黃素沉積於巨噬細胞內，表示儲存鐵增加；此倍率無法看到噬血現象本身。
features: Marrow particle with abundant blue, branching hemosiderin deposits within macrophages
Storage iron appears increased (high grade)
Surrounding hemodilute background of red cells
Cellular detail and hemophagocytosis not assessable at this power
2969.describe_en: Low-power Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a particle containing abundant coarse, branching blue hemosiderin deposits within macrophages, indicating increased storage iron. Individual cells and hemophagocytosis cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Increased marrow iron stores are a nonspecific finding that can accompany hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis with hyperferritinemia and inflammation-associated iron sequestration.

ddx.vs: Also shows increased macrophage iron with decreased sideroblasts; clinical HLH criteria are needed to separate them.
Iron overload is supported by transfusion history, transferrin saturation and HFE genotype rather than cytopenias with hemophagocytosis.
Sideroblastic anemia is defined by ringed sideroblasts in erythroblasts, which require high-power assessment.

2841.recognize_zh: 血片中可見三顆大型淋巴球，核偏心、染色質成熟，細胞質量多而淡藍，隱約有細小嗜天青顆粒，與旁邊的分葉核中性球大小相近，符合大顆粒淋巴球（LGL）。
features: Large lymphocytes, roughly the size of the adjacent neutrophil
Round to reniform, eccentric nuclei with mature condensed chromatin; no nucleoli
Abundant pale, clear to lightly basophilic cytoplasm
Sparse fine azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm (subtle at this magnification)
Background normocytic red cells and small platelet clumps; one segmented neutrophil
2841.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large lymphocytes with abundant pale cytoplasm, round to slightly indented eccentric nuclei and mature, condensed chromatin without nucleoli. Fine azurophilic granules are sparse and subtle in this field. A segmented neutrophil and small platelet clumps are present; red cells are unremarkable. In the setting of a persistent LGL count above 2 x 10^9/L with a clonal T-cell population (CD3+/CD8+/CD57+), findings are consistent with T-cell large granular lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs are morphologically identical; clonality by TCR gene rearrangement, STAT3 mutation and persistence over 6 months establish T-LGL leukemia.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-LGLs look the same but are surface CD3-negative, CD16/CD56-positive without TCR rearrangement.
Viral reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and more open chromatin, rather than pale granular cytoplasm.
Hairy cells have circumferential hairlike projections and agranular cytoplasm with oval or bean-shaped nuclei and are CD103/CD11c/CD25/annexin A1-positive B cells.

2521.recognize_zh: 腎臟切片（H&E）中，腎小管之間的間質被大量核偏位的漿細胞樣細胞浸潤，部分腎小管內有均質粉紅色管柱（casts），符合漿細胞腫瘤的腎臟浸潤。
features: Renal cortex with tubules separated by an expanded interstitium
Dense interstitial infiltrate of cells with round eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm (plasmacytoid)
Homogeneous eosinophilic casts within several tubular lumina
Tubular epithelial flattening and injury adjacent to the infiltrate
Congested capillaries with red cells; no glomeruli in this field
2521.describe_en: Section of renal cortex shows a dense interstitial infiltrate of discohesive cells with round eccentric nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, consistent with plasma cells, separating and distorting tubules. Several tubules contain homogeneous eosinophilic casts, with adjacent tubular epithelial injury. Glomeruli are not included in this field. Findings are consistent with renal parenchymal infiltration by a plasma cell neoplasm, compatible with plasma cell leukemia in context; the casts raise consideration of light chain cast nephropathy, and CD138 with kappa/lambda staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Drug-induced interstitial nephritis has a mixed infiltrate with lymphocytes and eosinophils and polytypic plasma cells rather than sheets of monotypic plasma cells.
IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with increased IgG4+ polytypic plasma cells, not a clonal infiltrate.
Lymphoma cells lack eccentric nuclei and hofs and are CD20 or CD3 positive and CD138 negative.
Ordinary hyaline casts are pale and smooth without fractures or giant-cell reaction, while myeloma casts are dense, fractured and light-chain restricted.

2201.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見數顆中型芽細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、偶見小核仁，只有一圈深藍色無顆粒細胞質，形態為淋巴芽細胞；Ph+（BCR-ABL1）無法從形態判斷，須靠細胞遺傳或分子檢查。
features: Medium-sized blasts, about 1.5–2 times RBC diameter
High N:C ratio with narrow rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin
Small nucleoli visible in some cells; occasional cytoplasmic blebs
No granules or Auer rods; background RBCs unremarkable, platelets sparse
2201.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating blasts of medium size with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli in some cells, and a narrow rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or granules are identified. Red cells are unremarkable and platelets appear decreased in this field. The morphology is that of lymphoblasts; the Philadelphia chromosome cannot be recognized morphologically. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia, with BCR::ABL1 confirmation by cytogenetics, FISH or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts may show granules, Auer rods and MPO positivity, whereas lymphoblasts are agranular and MPO negative with lymphoid markers by flow.
Morphologically identical; distinguished by a preceding chronic phase, basophilia and p210 BCR::ABL1 versus the p190 transcript typical of de novo Ph+ ALL.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant cytoplasm that indents around RBCs and mature chromatin, lacking the fine blastic chromatin seen here.

2073.recognize_zh: 低倍胃切片中，致密深藍色的淋巴細胞浸潤由固有層下方一路延伸到黏膜下層，將胃腺體推擠、分開並取代深部黏膜，這種在胃黏膜形成大片淋巴組織的表現是胃 MALT 淋巴瘤的低倍線索。
features: Dense, diffuse sheet of small basophilic lymphoid cells expanding the deep lamina propria and submucosa
Gastric glands in the superficial mucosa are separated, compressed and focally replaced by the infiltrate
Infiltrate extends toward the muscularis and adjacent fat at the lower right
Surface epithelium is largely preserved
Lymphoepithelial lesions and cytologic detail are not assessable at this magnification
2073.describe_en: Low-power section of gastric wall shows a dense, diffuse lymphoid infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and submucosa. The infiltrate separates and replaces the deeper gastric glands while the surface epithelium is relatively preserved, and it extends toward the deeper wall. Lymphoepithelial lesions and cell morphology cannot be assessed at this magnification. The pattern is suggestive of extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of MALT (gastric MALT lymphoma), to be confirmed by higher-power evaluation, immunohistochemistry and H. pylori assessment.

ddx.dx: Chronic H. pylori gastritis with lymphoid follicles
ddx.vs: Reactive gastritis shows discrete follicles with a mixed plasma cell infiltrate confined to the superficial mucosa, without destructive sheets or lymphoepithelial lesions and without light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the stomach
ddx.vs: DLBCL consists of sheets of large transformed cells with high proliferation rather than small marginal zone cells.
MCL is composed of monotonous small cleaved cells that are cyclin D1 and CD5 positive.

1881.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向一顆分葉核中性球核葉旁邊附著的小圓形染色質小突起（nuclear appendage），體積很小、沒有細長的柄，屬於正常中性球的核附屬物，不應誤判為鼓槌體或病理性包涵體。
features: Mature segmented neutrophil with 3-4 nuclear lobes
Tiny round chromatin knob attached to a nuclear lobe (arrow)
Appendage much smaller than a drumstick head and lacks a distinct thin stalk
Pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background normochromic red cells
1881.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with fine neutrophilic granules and normal lobation. A tiny round chromatin appendage is attached to one nuclear lobe (arrow); it is smaller than a drumstick and lacks a well-formed stalk. The surrounding red cells are unremarkable. Findings represent a nonspecific nuclear appendage of a normal neutrophil and have no pathologic significance.

ddx.vs: A drumstick has a ~1.5 µm round head attached to a lobe by a thin chromatin stalk and is seen in a small percentage of neutrophils in females, whereas small appendages lack this defined head-and-stalk shape.

ddx.dx: Döhle body or other cytoplasmic inclusion
ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches separate from the nucleus, whereas the appendage is purple chromatin continuous with a nuclear lobe.
Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more (or many with five) full-size lobes, whereas a small appendage is not counted as a lobe.

1817.recognize_zh: 紅血球背景中唯一的白血球是分三葉的嗜中性球，細胞質內靠近核葉之間可見一顆小而圓的淡色包涵體，疑為細菌聚集形成的桑椹體（morula）；因位於嗜中性球內，現今命名應屬 Anaplasma phagocytophilum（人類顆粒球無形體症），解析度有限。
features: Segmented neutrophil with three nuclear lobes as the only leukocyte in the field
Small round cytoplasmic inclusion between the nuclear lobes, compatible with a morula (limited resolution)
Neutrophil cytoplasm otherwise with fine granules
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without parasites
Small platelet clump and scattered platelets in the background
1817.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without intraerythrocytic organisms. A segmented neutrophil contains a small round cytoplasmic inclusion situated between the nuclear lobes, compatible with a bacterial morula, although the inclusion is small and resolution limits definitive characterization. Platelets are present in small clumps. In the appropriate clinical setting (tick exposure, fever, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, transaminitis), findings are suggestive of granulocytic anaplasmosis (formerly human granulocytic ehrlichiosis); PCR or serology is recommended because smear sensitivity is low.

ddx.vs: Morulae are found in monocytes rather than neutrophils and are detected in PB less often.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey, irregular, peripheral cytoplasmic patches of rough ER rather than a round, stippled basophilic inclusion.
Overlapping platelets show a granular purple center with a pale rim and lie in a different focal plane, whereas a morula is a mulberry-like cluster within a vacuole.
Yeasts are oval with a crescent-shaped nucleus and a clear halo, often several per cell.

1625.recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色下，一個卵圓形濾泡的中央（生發中心）呈中等棕色陽性，外圍一圈外套區染色較深且較暗，濾泡間區也有陽性細胞，勾勒出正常濾泡的生發中心與外套區分層。
features: Oval follicle with moderately positive brown staining of the germinal center
Darker, more intensely stained ring corresponding to the mantle zone
Positive cells also in the surrounding interfollicular/outer zone
Scattered unstained clear spaces and small vessels
Low magnification; specific antigen not identified in the image
1625.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of lymphoid tissue at low power shows an oval follicle in which the germinal center is moderately positive, surrounded by a more intensely and darkly staining mantle zone, with additional positive cells in the surrounding tissue. Unstained spaces and vessels are scattered throughout. The antigen is not specified; the pattern highlights the normal zonation of a secondary follicle and would fit a broadly expressed B-cell marker with stronger mantle zone expression. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded follicles without a distinct mantle ring and BCL2 positivity within follicle centers, whereas here the mantle zone is well delineated.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL shows a markedly widened mantle of cyclin D1-positive cells, which would need a specific stain rather than a pan-lymphoid pattern.

1433.recognize_zh: 雙格骨髓抹片：左格可見大型細胞具多個分離的圓形核與空泡狀胞質（類似核分離型的異常巨核細胞）；右格顆粒球系可見低顆粒、核分葉異常（如雙葉假 Pelger 型）及核形怪異的細胞，箭頭指出異常的未成熟顆粒球；兩個以上細胞系出現異型性，符合多系異常增生 MDS。
features: Two-panel composite of bone marrow aspirate fields
Left: large cells with multiple widely separated round nuclei and vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm with a central pink granular zone (dysplastic megakaryocyte with separated nuclei)
Right: dysgranulopoiesis with hypogranular neutrophils and abnormal nuclear segmentation (bilobed pseudo-Pelger-like and dumbbell forms)
Right: arrowed large immature granulocytic cell with abnormal nuclear-cytoplasmic maturation
Scattered erythroid precursors and small lymphocytes; no obvious blast excess in these selected fields
1433.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate fields shows dysplasia in more than one lineage. The left panel shows a large cell with multiple widely separated round nuclei and vacuolated cytoplasm, most consistent with a dysplastic megakaryocyte. The right panel shows dysgranulopoiesis, including hypogranular granulocytes with abnormal, bilobed or dumbbell-shaped nuclei and an arrowed immature granulocytic cell with asynchronous maturation. Blasts are not obviously increased in these selected fields. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia, provided blasts are below 5% and reactive causes are excluded.

ddx.vs: This requires 5-19% marrow blasts (or 2-19% in blood), which must be established by a full differential count rather than selected dysplastic fields.
Megaloblastic change produces giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented rather than hyposegmented neutrophils and resolves with B12/folate replacement.
Reactive dysplasia is usually transient with a clear exposure history and lacks clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.
Pelger-Huet anomaly shows uniformly bilobed neutrophils with normal granulation and no dysplasia in other lineages.

60505.recognize_zh: 細胞核分葉、染色質粗，細胞質中僅剩少數深紫色粗顆粒，其餘多為淡色空洞樣區域，是嗜鹼性顆粒在染色時被水洗脫（washed-out granules）的嗜鹼性球。
features: Granulocyte slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Lobated nucleus with condensed, dark chromatin, now clearly visible
Cytoplasm with residual scattered coarse dark purple granules
Numerous pale, empty-appearing vacuole-like spaces where granules have dissolved
A small platelet at the upper left of the cell; background normochromic red cells
60505.describe_en: High-power peripheral blood smear shows a granulocyte with a lobated nucleus with condensed chromatin. The cytoplasm contains a reduced number of coarse dark purple granules and numerous pale, empty-appearing spaces, giving a vacuolated appearance. Because the granules are diminished, the nucleus is more visible than in a typical basophil. Findings are consistent with a basophil with water-soluble granules partially washed out during staining, an artifact rather than true dysplastic degranulation.

ddx.vs: Toxic neutrophils have pale pink cytoplasm with fine toxic granules and discrete vacuoles, not residual coarse purple-black basophilic granules.
Morphology may overlap; true dysplasia is persistent across well-stained smears and accompanied by other dysplastic changes, whereas washout is technical.
Mast cells have a round non-lobated nucleus and densely packed uniform granules that are not water soluble.

89.recognize_zh: 扁桃腺淋巴組織呈多形性（polymorphous）浸潤：小淋巴球、漿細胞、組織球中夾雜散在的大型免疫母細胞（immunoblast），偶見類 Reed-Sternberg 細胞；EBER 原位雜交顯示大小不一的散在陽性細胞，但沒有成片的單一大型 B 細胞，因此判讀為年長者的 EBV 再活化。
features: Tonsillar tissue with overlying squamous epithelium and a mottled, expanded interfollicular/paracortical lymphoid proliferation
Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes and scattered large immunoblasts with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Occasional binucleate or multilobated Reed-Sternberg-like large cells, not forming sheets
IHC: abundant T cells in the background with scattered large cells positive for a membranous marker, and a residual follicle
EBER ISH: numerous scattered nuclear-positive cells ranging from small lymphocytes to large immunoblasts, without confluent sheets
89.describe_en: Tonsillar biopsy shows surface squamous mucosa overlying a mottled lymphoid proliferation with interfollicular expansion; the low-power image is of limited resolution. At high power the infiltrate is polymorphous, composed of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes and scattered large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, including occasional binucleate Reed-Sternberg-like forms; sheets of monomorphic large cells are not identified. Immunohistochemistry shows an abundant background T-cell population with scattered large cells highlighted by membranous staining and preserved follicular structures (marker labels are not provided in the images). EBER in situ hybridization shows numerous scattered positive cells of variable size, both small and large. In the absence of sheets of large B cells or systemic disease, findings are consistent with a polymorphous EBV-positive reactive lymphoid proliferation (EBV reactivation) in an older adult.

ddx.dx: EBV-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL shows confluent sheets of monomorphic or polymorphic large EBER+ B cells effacing architecture, whereas here the large EBER+ cells are scattered in a polymorphous background with preserved follicles.

True HRS cells in CHL are CD30+ CD15+ with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/CD45, and EBER is confined to HRS cells, whereas here Reed-Sternberg-like cells are B-immunoblasts retaining CD20/CD45 and EBER labels many small and large cells.

IM shows the same polymorphous immunoblastic pattern but occurs in young patients with fever, pharyngitis, lymphocytosis and positive heterophile/primary EBV serology, unlike this afebrile older adult with a normal CBC.

EBVMCU forms a sharply circumscribed ulcer with a polymorphous infiltrate and a rim of T cells in an immunosuppressed or elderly patient; the absence of ulceration favors reactivation-type hyperplasia.

89.stain: H&E; IHC (lymphoid markers, not labeled); ISH: EBER
captions: H&E, low power (limited resolution): tonsil with squamous mucosa and mottled lymphoid expansion
H&E, high power: polymorphous infiltrate with scattered immunoblasts, plasma cells and histiocytes
H&E, high power: large immunoblasts including a Reed-Sternberg-like multilobated cell
IHC (marker not labeled): scattered large cells with strong membranous staining
IHC (T-cell-type marker, not labeled): abundant positive background T cells
IHC (T-cell-type marker, not labeled): positive interfollicular cells surrounding a less-stained follicle
IHC (marker not labeled): scattered positive medium to large cells with weak background staining
IHC (marker not labeled): numerous scattered positive cells in a mixed infiltrate
EBER ISH, medium power: many scattered nuclear-positive cells
EBER ISH, high power: positive nuclei in both small lymphocytes and large immunoblasts

25.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有成團、黏合成群的小圓藍細胞（small round blue cells），細胞核相互擠壓，可見圍繞中央纖維狀物質的菊形團（Homer Wright rosette 樣排列）與淡粉紅纖維狀背景（neuropil），在幼童合併腹部腫塊時最符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive clusters and sheets of small to medium round blue cells with high N:C ratio, distinct from dispersed hematopoietic cells
Nuclear molding with round to oval nuclei, finely granular (salt-and-pepper) chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Rosette-like arrangement of tumor cells around central pale fibrillary material (Homer Wright pseudorosette)
Scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles
Background pink-purple fibrillary neuropil-like material between tumor cells
25.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear contains large cohesive aggregates of tumor cells that stand out from the background hematopoietic elements at low power. The cells are small to medium sized with high N:C ratio, round nuclei showing molding, finely granular chromatin and scant basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm. Rosette-like clusters around central fibrillary material and a pink fibrillary neuropil-like background are present. In a 2-year-old with an abdominal mass, findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow; confirmation by immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, chromogranin, CD56 positive, CD45 negative) and urine catecholamines is recommended.

ddx.vs: Blasts are dispersed singly without cohesive clusters, rosettes or neuropil, and are CD45/TdT positive rather than PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive.
Also forms small round blue cell clusters, but shows cytoplasmic glycogen vacuoles without neuropil and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Cells may mimic hematopoietic blasts or clusters, but are desmin/myogenin positive with FOXO1 fusion and lack neuropil.
A renal mass in this age group, but marrow metastasis is rare, and the tumor is WT1 positive with blastemal/epithelial/stromal elements rather than neuropil and rosettes.

captions: Low power: large cohesive aggregate of tumor cells within the aspirate
Medium power: cohesive cluster of small round blue cells with molding and vacuoles
High power: rosette-like cluster around central fibrillary material
Sheets of tumor cells in a pink fibrillary neuropil-like background

65113.recognize_zh: 視野中央是一顆體積很大、細胞質充滿紫紅細顆粒的成熟巨核細胞，但它的核只有一個小而圓、不分葉的團塊，偏在一側，與巨大的細胞質極不相稱，這就是低分葉巨核細胞（hypolobated megakaryocyte）的發育不良表現。
features: Large mature megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm indicating cytoplasmic maturity
Single small, round, non-lobated nucleus with dense chromatin, markedly disproportionate to cell size
No nuclear lobation or separated nuclear lobes
Background of erythrocytes and scattered small erythroid precursors and lymphoid/myeloid cells
65113.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant mature granular cytoplasm and a single small, round, non-lobated nucleus. The nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, with full cytoplasmic maturation but lack of nuclear lobulation, represents dysmegakaryopoiesis. Surrounding hematopoietic cells are not evaluable for dysplasia in this single field. The finding is consistent with a hypolobated megakaryocyte, as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasms (classically MDS with isolated del(5q)) and some myeloproliferative or MDS/MPN overlap disorders.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small cells about the size of a promyelocyte with one or two nuclei, whereas this cell is large with abundant cytoplasm.
The separated-nuclei form shows multiple discrete round nuclear lobes ('pawn ball'), in contrast to the single compact nucleus here.
Immature megakaryocytes have scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm, while this cell has fully granular mature cytoplasm with an unlobated nucleus.
Macrophages contain phagocytosed debris and vacuoles, and osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform nuclei, unlike the single nucleus and platelet-type granules here.

62489.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD34 染色主要標出線狀、分支的血管內皮，另外有散在單個的圓形小陽性細胞（芽細胞）；背景是大量顆粒球系細胞與多顆小型、低分葉的巨核細胞（CD34 陰性），用來估算 CML 加速期的芽細胞比例並排除芽細胞聚集。
features: Hypercellular marrow with granulocytic predominance and numerous small, hypolobated megakaryocytes (CD34-negative)
CD34 strongly highlights elongated, branching vascular endothelium
Scattered individual small round CD34-positive cells consistent with blasts
No large clusters or sheets of CD34-positive blasts in this field
Background granulocytic precursors negative
62489.describe_en: CD34 immunohistochemistry on a hypercellular bone marrow core biopsy highlights prominent branching vasculature and scattered, individually distributed small CD34-positive blasts. The background consists of CD34-negative granulocytic precursors and numerous small, hypolobated megakaryocytes. No large clusters or sheets of blasts are identified in this field, and the blast percentage should be quantified across the entire core together with the aspirate differential. In the context of BCR::ABL1-positive CML with accelerated-phase features, the stain supports an increased but not blast-phase level of CD34-positive cells.

ddx.vs: Blast phase shows ≥20% blasts or large focal clusters/sheets of CD34-positive blasts replacing marrow, which are not seen here.
Chronic phase has <10% blasts with only rare CD34-positive cells, so quantitative comparison and other criteria (basophils, platelets, additional cytogenetic abnormalities) are needed.
PMF also shows increased vascularity and CD34+ cells, but megakaryocytes are large, atypical and clustered with cloud-like nuclei, and BCR::ABL1 is absent.
MDS shows multilineage dysplasia with abnormally localized immature precursors in a usually non-granulocytic-dominant marrow and is BCR::ABL1-negative.

60121.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀圖：先以 SSC 對 CD15 圈出顆粒球，再看 FLAER 與 CD55/CD59；正常人顆粒球全落在雙陽性區，PNH 病人約 85.8% 顆粒球落在 FLAER 陰性、CD55/59 陰性的左下象限，代表大型 PNH 克隆（GPI 錨定蛋白缺失）。
features: Granulocytes gated on SSC versus CD15 (red population) in both normal and patient samples
Normal control: 99.88% of granulocytes are FLAER-positive and CD55/CD59-positive (upper right quadrant)
PNH patient: 85.83% of granulocytes are FLAER-negative and CD55/CD59-negative (lower left quadrant), the type III PNH clone
PNH patient: residual 12.79% FLAER/CD55/CD59-positive normal neutrophils
Discrete separation between clone and normal cells, with few events in intermediate positions
60121.describe_en: Peripheral blood high-sensitivity flow cytometry for PNH. Granulocytes were gated on side scatter versus CD15 and assessed for FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression. In the normal control, 99.88% of granulocytes co-express FLAER and CD55/CD59. In the patient sample, 85.83% of granulocytes lack both FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression, with a residual 12.79% normal granulocyte population. Findings demonstrate a large PNH clone involving approximately 86% of granulocytes, consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; correlation with red cell (CD59, type II/III) and monocyte clone sizes, LDH, and marrow findings is recommended.

ddx.dx: Small PNH clone in aplastic anemia or MDS
ddx.vs: Clone size is typically below 10% of granulocytes, whereas this sample shows an 86% clone.
Isolated CD59 deficiency involves all cells with preserved FLAER binding because other GPI-anchored proteins remain intact.
Immature myeloid cells may show dim CD55/CD59 but retain FLAER binding and do not form a discrete double-negative population.

3865.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組化（標記未標明）中，細胞豐富的背景裡只有散在的小型圓形細胞呈環狀膜/胞質棕色陽性，中央一個核較淡、細胞排列鬆散的區域（疑為肉芽腫）內外有較多陽性細胞聚集；本身無法看到組織漿菌，需配合 GMS/PAS 染色。
features: Hypercellular marrow core with hematoxylin-counterstained negative hematopoietic cells
Scattered small round cells with crisp ring-like membranous/cytoplasmic brown positivity
Loose central zone with paler, oval epithelioid-type nuclei, suggestive of a granuloma, with a small cluster of positive cells in and around it
Marker identity not provided; organisms are not visible on this stain
3865.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antigen not specified) on a hypercellular bone marrow core shows scattered positive small round cells with crisp ring-like membranous staining among negative hematopoietic elements. A central, loosely arranged area of pale oval epithelioid-appearing nuclei, suggestive of a granuloma, contains a small aggregate of positive cells at its periphery and within it. Because the marker is not stated, the positive cells cannot be definitively assigned to a lineage, and fungal organisms are not assessable on this preparation. The appearance is compatible with a lymphocyte subset accompanying a marrow granuloma in disseminated histoplasmosis; GMS or PAS stains and culture are required to demonstrate Histoplasma.

ddx.vs: Mycobacterial granulomas look similar and are distinguished by acid-fast stain and culture/PCR rather than by immunophenotype of accompanying cells.
Sarcoid granulomas are well-formed, non-necrotizing and remain negative on GMS, PAS and acid-fast stains.
Hodgkin involvement shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin-Reed-Sternberg cells within a mixed infiltrate and often fibrosis.
